import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import type { TicketStatus } from '../model/types';

type TicketStatusBadgeProps = {
  status: TicketStatus | string;
};

export function TicketStatusBadge({ status }: TicketStatusBadgeProps) {
  let label = 'Pendiente';
  let badgeClasses = 'bg-sky/30 border-sky/70';
  let textClasses = 'text-petrol';
  let dotColor = 'bg-steel';

  if (status === 'in_progress') {
    label = 'En proceso';
    badgeClasses = 'bg-petrol/10 border-petrol/30';
    textClasses = 'text-petrol';
    dotColor = 'bg-petrol';
  } else if (status === 'resolved') {
    label = 'Resuelto';
    badgeClasses = 'bg-steel/10 border-steel/30';
    textClasses = 'text-steel';
    dotColor = 'bg-steel';
  } else if (status === 'cancelled') {
    label = 'Cancelado';
    badgeClasses = 'bg-coral/10 border-coral/30';
    textClasses = 'text-coral';
    dotColor = 'bg-coral';
  }

  return (
    <View
      className={`flex-row items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 ${badgeClasses}`}>
      <View className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dotColor}`} />
      <Text className={`text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider ${textClasses}`}>
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Modal, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Shield, ShieldAlert, X } from 'lucide-react-native';

import type { Profile, UserRole } from '@/entities/session';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

type ChangeRoleModalProps = {
  targetUser: Profile | null;
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (userId: string, newRole: UserRole) => void;
};

export function ChangeRoleModal({
  targetUser,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: ChangeRoleModalProps) {
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState<'requester' | 'support'>('requester');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!targetUser) return null;

  const currentRole = targetUser.role;
  const isTargetAdmin = currentRole === 'admin';

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    if (isTargetAdmin) {
      setErrorMessage('No está permitido modificar el rol de un administrador.');
      return;
    }

    if (selectedRole === currentRole) {
      onClose();
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc('admin_set_user_role', {
        p_user_id: targetUser.id,
        p_new_role: selectedRole,
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al cambiar rol en Supabase:', error);
        setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo actualizar el rol del usuario.');
        return;
      }

      onSuccess(targetUser.id, selectedRole);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al cambiar rol:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Error al conectar con el servidor.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={onClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[400px] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Cabecera */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-sky/20 pb-3">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                <Shield color={COLORS.PETROL} size={18} />
              </View>
              <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
                Asignar rol de usuario
              </Text>
            </View>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas"
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={onClose}>
              <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {/* Información del usuario */}
          <View className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-canvas p-3.5">
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-steel">
              Usuario seleccionado
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
              {targetUser.full_name || 'Sin nombre registrado'}
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
              {targetUser.email}
            </Text>
            <View className="mt-2 self-start rounded-full bg-sky/30 px-2 py-0.5">
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-petrol">
                Rol actual: {currentRole === 'admin' ? 'Administrador' : currentRole === 'support' ? 'Soporte' : 'Solicitante'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {isTargetAdmin ? (
            <View className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldAlert color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
              <Text className="flex-1 text-xs text-coral font-medium">
                Las cuentas de administrador no pueden ser modificadas desde este panel.
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View className="mt-4 gap-2">
              <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">
                Selecciona el nuevo rol:
              </Text>

              {/* Selector entre requester y support */}
              {(['requester', 'support'] as const).map((r) => {
                const isSelected = selectedRole === r;
                const label = r === 'requester' ? 'Solicitante' : 'Especialista de Soporte';
                const desc =
                  r === 'requester'
                    ? 'Puede crear tickets e interactuar en sus incidencias.'
                    : 'Puede reclamar, atender y resolver tickets de la cola.';

                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={r}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className={`rounded-2xl border p-3 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-petrol bg-petrol/5'
                        : 'border-sky/40 bg-white active:bg-canvas'
                    }`}
                    disabled={loading}
                    onPress={() => setSelectedRole(r)}>
                    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
                      <Text
                        className={`text-sm font-bold ${
                          isSelected ? 'text-petrol' : 'text-steel'
                        }`}>
                        {label}
                      </Text>
                      <View
                        className={`h-4 w-4 rounded-full border items-center justify-center ${
                          isSelected ? 'border-petrol bg-petrol' : 'border-sky'
                        }`}>
                        {isSelected ? (
                          <View className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white" />
                        ) : null}
                      </View>
                    </View>
                    <Text className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-steel">
                      {desc}
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          )}

          {errorMessage ? (
            <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-2.5">
              <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                {errorMessage}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Botones de acción */}
          <View className="mt-5 gap-2.5">
            {!isTargetAdmin ? (
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className={`h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol shadow-sm ${
                  loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
                }`}
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={handleConfirm}>
                {loading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                    Confirmar cambio de rol
                  </Text>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-10 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-sky/40 bg-white"
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={onClose}>
              <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-steel">Cancelar</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';

import welcomeBadgeAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/welcome-badge.json';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { AppLogo } from '@/shared/ui/app-logo';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

type ForgotPasswordModalProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialEmail?: string;
};

export function ForgotPasswordModal({
  visible,
  onClose,
  initialEmail = '',
}: ForgotPasswordModalProps) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(initialEmail);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (loading) return;
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setIsSuccess(false);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleResetPassword = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();

    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu correo electrónico.');
      return;
    }

    if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(trimmedEmail)) {
      setErrorMessage('Ingresa un correo electrónico válido (ej. usuario@empresa.com).');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const webUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL;
    const redirectTo = `${webUrl}/auth/reset-password`;

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(trimmedEmail, {
      redirectTo,
    });

    setLoading(false);

    if (error) {
      const msg = error.message.toLowerCase();
      if (msg.includes('rate limit') || msg.includes('too many requests')) {
        setErrorMessage(
          'Demasiadas solicitudes. Por favor, espera unos momentos antes de intentar de nuevo.'
        );
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo enviar el correo de recuperación.');
      }
      return;
    }

    setIsSuccess(true);
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-5">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          onPress={handleClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[420px] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-lg">
          {isSuccess ? (
            <View className="items-center py-2">
              <View className="mb-2 h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center">
                <LottieView
                  autoPlay
                  loop
                  source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                  style={{ width: 80, height: 80 }}
                />
              </View>

              <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
                ENLACE ENVIADO
              </Text>

              <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-xl font-bold text-petrol">
                Revisa tu correo
              </Text>

              <Text className="mt-3 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-steel">
                Hemos enviado las instrucciones para restablecer tu contraseña a{' '}
                <Text className="font-semibold text-petrol">{email.trim()}</Text>. Sigue el
                enlace recibido para crear tu nueva contraseña.
              </Text>

              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="mt-6 h-14 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol active:opacity-90"
                onPress={handleClose}>
                <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                  Volver al inicio de sesión
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View>
              <View className="mb-4 flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <AppLogo size="sm" />

                <Pressable
                  accessibilityLabel="Cerrar"
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas active:opacity-70"
                  hitSlop={8}
                  onPress={handleClose}>
                  <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                </Pressable>
              </View>

              <View className="mb-3">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
                  RECUPERACIÓN
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-xl font-bold text-petrol">
                  Restablecer contraseña
                </Text>
              </View>

              <Text className="mb-5 text-sm leading-5 text-steel">
                Ingresa el correo electrónico asociado a tu cuenta y te enviaremos un enlace
                seguro para crear una nueva contraseña.
              </Text>

              <TextField
                autoCapitalize="none"
                autoComplete="email"
                keyboardType="email-address"
                label="Correo electrónico"
                onChangeText={(val) => {
                  setEmail(val);
                  if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                }}
                placeholder="tu@empresa.com"
                textContentType="emailAddress"
                value={email}
              />

              {errorMessage ? (
                <View className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
                  <Text className="text-xs font-medium text-coral">{errorMessage}</Text>
                </View>
              ) : null}

              <Pressable
                accessibilityHint="Envía el correo de recuperación a tu dirección."
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className={`mt-6 h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol ${
                  loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
                }`}
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={handleResetPassword}>
                {loading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" />
                ) : (
                  <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">
                    Enviar enlace de recuperación
                  </Text>
                )}
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="mt-3 h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl active:opacity-70"
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={handleClose}>
                <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-steel">Cancelar</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import type { AuthError } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import * as WebBrowser from 'expo-web-browser';
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { useSession, type UserRole } from '@/entities/session';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { GoogleIcon } from '@/shared/ui/google-icon';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';
import { ForgotPasswordModal } from './forgot-password-modal';

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

type TargetRoute = `/${UserRole}` | '/dashboard';

function getFriendlyErrorMessage(error: AuthError): string {
  const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
  if (message.includes('invalid login credentials')) {
    return 'Credenciales incorrectas. Verifica tu correo y contraseña.';
  }
  if (message.includes('email not confirmed')) {
    return 'Tu correo electrónico no ha sido confirmado. Revisa tu bandeja de entrada.';
  }
  if (message.includes('too many requests')) {
    return 'Demasiados intentos fallidos. Espera unos momentos antes de reintentar.';
  }
  return error.message || 'Ocurrió un error al iniciar sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo.';
}

export function LoginForm() {
  const { profile, setPendingWelcome } = useSession();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [forgotModalVisible, setForgotModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    if (loading || googleLoading) return;

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();

    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu correo electrónico.');
      return;
    }

    if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(trimmedEmail)) {
      setErrorMessage('Ingresa un correo electrónico válido (ej. usuario@empresa.com).');
      return;
    }

    if (!password) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu contraseña.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: trimmedEmail,
      password,
    });

    setLoading(false);

    if (error) {
      setErrorMessage(getFriendlyErrorMessage(error));
      return;
    }

    // Sesión iniciada con éxito -> Activar bienvenida y dirigir al usuario a su panel correspondiente
    setPendingWelcome(true);
    const targetRoute: TargetRoute = profile?.role ? `/${profile.role}` : '/dashboard';
    router.replace({ pathname: targetRoute, params: { welcome: '1' } });
  };

  const handleGoogleLogin = async () => {
    if (loading || googleLoading) return;
    setGoogleLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession();
      const redirectTo = Linking.createURL('google-auth');

      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
        provider: 'google',
        options: {
          redirectTo,
          skipBrowserRedirect: true,
        },
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al iniciar OAuth con Google:', error);
        if (
          error.message?.toLowerCase().includes('not enabled') ||
          error.message?.toLowerCase().includes('unsupported provider')
        ) {
          setErrorMessage(
            'El proveedor de Google no está habilitado en la consola de Supabase. Revisa las credenciales de Google Cloud Console.'
          );
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo iniciar sesión con Google.');
        }
        return;
      }

      if (!data?.url) {
        setErrorMessage('No se recibió la URL de autenticación de Google desde Supabase.');
        return;
      }

      // Abrir sesión segura en el navegador del dispositivo (Custom Tabs en Android)
      const res = await WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(data.url, redirectTo);

      if (res.type === 'success' && res.url) {
        const parsed = Linking.parse(res.url);
        const code =
          typeof parsed.queryParams?.code === 'string' ? parsed.queryParams.code : undefined;

        if (code) {
          const { error: exchangeError } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
          if (
            exchangeError &&
            !exchangeError.message.toLowerCase().includes('already') &&
            !exchangeError.message.toLowerCase().includes('flow state')
          ) {
            console.error('Error al intercambiar código:', exchangeError.message);
            setErrorMessage(exchangeError.message || 'Error al autenticar con Google.');
            return;
          }
          setPendingWelcome(true);
        } else if (res.url.includes('access_token')) {
          const hashOrQuery = res.url.includes('#') ? res.url.split('#')[1] : res.url.split('?')[1];
          if (hashOrQuery) {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(hashOrQuery);
            const accessToken = params.get('access_token');
            const refreshToken = params.get('refresh_token');
            if (accessToken && refreshToken) {
              const { error: sessionError } = await supabase.auth.setSession({
                access_token: accessToken,
                refresh_token: refreshToken,
              });
              if (sessionError) {
                console.error('Error al establecer sesión:', sessionError.message);
                setErrorMessage(sessionError.message || 'Error al establecer sesión con Google.');
                return;
              }
              setPendingWelcome(true);
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (res.type === 'cancel' || res.type === 'dismiss') {
        console.info('Inicio de sesión con Google cancelado por el usuario.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al conectar con Google OAuth:', err);
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error de conexión al conectar con Google.';
      setErrorMessage(msg);
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="w-full">
      <View className="gap-5">
        <TextField
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoCorrect={false}
          editable={!loading && !googleLoading}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          label="Correo electrónico"
          onChangeText={(val) => {
            setEmail(val);
            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
          }}
          placeholder="nombre@empresa.com"
          value={email}
        />

        <TextField
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoCorrect={false}
          editable={!loading && !googleLoading}
          label="Contraseña"
          onChangeText={(val) => {
            setPassword(val);
            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
          }}
          placeholder="Tu contraseña"
          rightElement={
            <Pressable
              accessibilityHint="Muestra u oculta los caracteres de la contraseña."
              accessibilityLabel={showPassword ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Ver contraseña'}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              hitSlop={8}
              onPress={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
              {showPassword ? (
                <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={20} />
              ) : (
                <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={20} />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          }
          secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
          value={password}
        />
      </View>

      <View className="mt-3 flex-row justify-end">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          disabled={loading || googleLoading}
          hitSlop={8}
          onPress={() => setForgotModalVisible(true)}>
          <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-coral">¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {errorMessage ? (
        <View className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
          <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">{errorMessage}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <Pressable
        accessibilityHint="Inicia sesión con tus credenciales tradicionales."
        accessibilityRole="button"
        className={`mt-7 h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol ${
          loading || googleLoading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
        }`}
        disabled={loading || googleLoading}
        onPress={handleLogin}>
        {loading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" />
        ) : (
          <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">Iniciar sesión</Text>
        )}
      </Pressable>

      <View className="my-6 flex-row items-center gap-4">
        <View className="h-px flex-1 bg-sky" />
        <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[1px] text-steel">O CONTINÚA CON</Text>
        <View className="h-px flex-1 bg-sky" />
      </View>

      <Pressable
        accessibilityHint="Inicia sesión con tu cuenta de Google."
        accessibilityRole="button"
        className={`h-14 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-sky/70 bg-white ${
          loading || googleLoading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-canvas'
        }`}
        disabled={loading || googleLoading}
        onPress={handleGoogleLogin}>
        {googleLoading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="small" />
        ) : (
          <>
            <GoogleIcon size={20} />
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-petrol">Continuar con Google</Text>
          </>
        )}
      </Pressable>

      <View className="mt-7 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1">
        <Text className="text-sm text-steel">¿Aún no tienes una cuenta?</Text>
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          disabled={loading || googleLoading}
          hitSlop={8}
          onPress={() => router.push('/register')}>
          <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-petrol">Crear cuenta</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {forgotModalVisible ? (
        <ForgotPasswordModal
          initialEmail={email}
          onClose={() => setForgotModalVisible(false)}
          visible={forgotModalVisible}
        />
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import type { AuthError } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { CheckCircle2, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

function getFriendlyRegisterError(error: AuthError): string {
  const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
  if (message.includes('user already registered') || message.includes('already exists')) {
    return 'Ya existe una cuenta registrada con este correo electrónico.';
  }
  if (
    message.includes('password') &&
    (message.includes('least') ||
      message.includes('short') ||
      message.includes('weak') ||
      message.includes('characters'))
  ) {
    return 'La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.';
  }
  if (message.includes('valid email')) {
    return 'Ingresa un correo electrónico válido.';
  }
  return error.message || 'Ocurrió un error al registrar la cuenta. Inténtalo de nuevo.';
}

export function RegisterForm() {
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);

  const handleRegister = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    const trimmedName = fullName.trim();
    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();

    if (!trimmedName) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu nombre completo.');
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu correo electrónico.');
      return;
    }

    if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(trimmedEmail)) {
      setErrorMessage('Ingresa un correo electrónico válido (ej. usuario@empresa.com).');
      return;
    }

    if (!password) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa una contraseña.');
      return;
    }

    if (password.length < 8) {
      setErrorMessage('La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Las contraseñas no coinciden.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    const webUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL;
    const emailRedirectTo = webUrl ? `${webUrl}/auth/confirm` : Linking.createURL('/');

    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email: trimmedEmail,
      password,
      options: {
        emailRedirectTo,
        data: {
          full_name: trimmedName,
        },
      },
    });

    setLoading(false);

    if (error) {
      setErrorMessage(getFriendlyRegisterError(error));
      return;
    }

    if (data.user && Array.isArray(data.user.identities) && data.user.identities.length === 0) {
      setErrorMessage('Ya existe una cuenta registrada con este correo electrónico.');
      return;
    }

    if (data.session) {
      // Si la confirmación de email no es requerida en Supabase, la sesión se inicia directamente.
      router.replace('/');
    } else {
      // Si Supabase requiere confirmación por email
      setSuccessMessage(
        '¡Cuenta creada con éxito! Hemos enviado un enlace de confirmación a tu correo. Por favor, revisa tu bandeja de entrada antes de iniciar sesión.'
      );
    }
  };

  if (successMessage) {
    return (
      <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky bg-white p-6">
        <View className="mb-3 h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
          <CheckCircle2 color={COLORS.PETROL} size={22} />
        </View>
        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-petrol">Registro exitoso</Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-steel">{successMessage}</Text>
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          className="mt-6 h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol active:opacity-90"
          onPress={() => router.replace('/')}>
          <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Ir al inicio de sesión</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <TextField
        autoCapitalize="words"
        autoComplete="name"
        label="Nombre completo"
        onChangeText={(val) => {
          setFullName(val);
          if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
        }}
        placeholder="Ej. Ana Martínez"
        textContentType="name"
        value={fullName}
      />

      <View className="mt-5">
        <TextField
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="email"
          keyboardType="email-address"
          label="Correo electrónico"
          onChangeText={(val) => {
            setEmail(val);
            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
          }}
          placeholder="tu@empresa.com"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          value={email}
        />
      </View>

      <View className="mt-5">
        <TextField
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="new-password"
          label="Contraseña"
          onChangeText={(val) => {
            setPassword(val);
            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
          }}
          placeholder="Mínimo 8 caracteres"
          rightElement={
            <Pressable
              accessibilityLabel={showPassword ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              hitSlop={8}
              onPress={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
              {showPassword ? (
                <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={19} />
              ) : (
                <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={19} />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          }
          secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
          textContentType="newPassword"
          value={password}
        />
      </View>

      <View className="mt-5">
        <TextField
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="new-password"
          label="Confirmar contraseña"
          onChangeText={(val) => {
            setConfirmPassword(val);
            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
          }}
          placeholder="Repite tu contraseña"
          rightElement={
            <Pressable
              accessibilityLabel={showConfirmPassword ? 'Ocultar contraseña' : 'Mostrar contraseña'}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              hitSlop={8}
              onPress={() => setShowConfirmPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
              {showConfirmPassword ? (
                <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={19} />
              ) : (
                <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={19} />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          }
          secureTextEntry={!showConfirmPassword}
          textContentType="newPassword"
          value={confirmPassword}
        />
      </View>

      {errorMessage ? (
        <View className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
          <Text className="text-xs font-medium text-coral">{errorMessage}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      <Pressable
        accessibilityHint="Crea una cuenta nueva con los datos ingresados."
        accessibilityRole="button"
        className={`mt-6 h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol ${
          loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
        }`}
        disabled={loading}
        onPress={handleRegister}>
        {loading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" />
        ) : (
          <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">Crear cuenta</Text>
        )}
      </Pressable>

      <View className="mt-7 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1">
        <Text className="text-sm text-steel">¿Ya tienes una cuenta?</Text>
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          hitSlop={8}
          onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-petrol">Iniciar sesión</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Modal, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { LogOut } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

type SignOutConfirmModalProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSignOut?: () => Promise<void>;
};

export function SignOutConfirmModal({
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSignOut,
}: SignOutConfirmModalProps) {
  const { signOut } = useSession();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (loading) return;
    setErrorMessage(null);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      if (onSignOut) {
        await onSignOut();
      } else {
        await signOut();
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error al cerrar sesión:', err);
      setErrorMessage(
        err instanceof Error && err.message
          ? err.message
          : 'Ocurrió un error al intentar cerrar la sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo.'
      );
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar ventana de confirmación"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={handleClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[380px] items-center rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-xl">
          {/* Icono de advertencia / cierre de sesión */}
          <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-coral/10">
            <LogOut color={COLORS.CORAL} size={24} />
          </View>

          {/* Título */}
          <Text className="mt-4 text-center text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
            ¿Cerrar sesión?
          </Text>

          {/* Mensaje */}
          <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-steel">
            ¿Estás seguro de que deseas cerrar tu sesión?
          </Text>

          {/* Mensaje de error en caso de fallo */}
          {errorMessage ? (
            <View className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
              <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                {errorMessage}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {/* Botones de acción */}
          <View className="mt-6 w-full gap-3">
            <Pressable
              accessibilityHint="Confirma el cierre de tu sesión y vuelve a la pantalla de ingreso."
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className={`h-13 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-coral shadow-sm ${
                loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:opacity-90'
              }`}
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={handleConfirm}>
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#ffffff" size="small" />
              ) : (
                <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">
                  Sí, cerrar sesión
                </Text>
              )}
            </Pressable>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityHint="Cancela el cierre de sesión y permanece en la aplicación."
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className={`h-11 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-sky/50 bg-white active:bg-canvas ${
                loading ? 'opacity-50' : ''
              }`}
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={handleClose}>
              <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-steel">Cancelar</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import { Eye, EyeOff, KeyRound, X } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import welcomeBadgeAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/welcome-badge.json';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';

type ChangePasswordModalProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export function ChangePasswordModal({ visible, onClose }: ChangePasswordModalProps) {
  const { user } = useSession();

  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');

  const [showCurrentPassword, setShowCurrentPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showNewPassword, setShowNewPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setCurrentPassword('');
    setNewPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setShowCurrentPassword(false);
    setShowNewPassword(false);
    setShowConfirmPassword(false);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (loading) return;
    resetForm();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleChangePassword = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    if (!user?.email) {
      setErrorMessage('No se encontró el correo de la sesión activa.');
      return;
    }

    // 1. Validación de campos vacíos
    if (!currentPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa tu contraseña actual.');
      return;
    }

    if (!newPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa la nueva contraseña.');
      return;
    }

    if (!confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, confirma la nueva contraseña.');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Validación de longitud mínima y seguridad
    if (newPassword.length < 8) {
      setErrorMessage('La nueva contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Comprobar que sea distinta a la actual
    if (newPassword === currentPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('La nueva contraseña debe ser diferente a la contraseña actual.');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Comprobación de coincidencia
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Las contraseñas nuevas no coinciden.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      // Mecanismo seguro de Supabase: re-autenticar con la contraseña actual antes de actualizar
      const { error: signInError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email: user.email,
        password: currentPassword,
      });

      if (signInError) {
        console.warn('Fallo de verificación de contraseña actual:', signInError.message);
        setErrorMessage('La contraseña actual es incorrecta. Verifícala e intenta nuevamente.');
        return;
      }

      // Actualizar a la nueva contraseña mediante Supabase Auth
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
        password: newPassword,
      });

      if (updateError) {
        console.error('Error al actualizar contraseña:', updateError);
        setErrorMessage(updateError.message || 'No se pudo actualizar la contraseña.');
        return;
      }

      // Éxito: limpiar campos y mostrar mensaje positivo
      setCurrentPassword('');
      setNewPassword('');
      setConfirmPassword('');
      setSuccessMessage('¡Tu contraseña ha sido actualizada con éxito! Tu nueva clave de acceso ya está activa.');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al cambiar contraseña:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Error de conexión al procesar el cambio de contraseña.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-5 py-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          onPress={handleClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[460px] max-h-[92%] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Cabecera */}
          <View className="mb-4 flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-sky/30 pb-3">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                <KeyRound color={COLORS.PETROL} size={18} />
              </View>
              <View>
                <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
                  Cambiar contraseña
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-steel">
                  SEGURIDAD DE LA CUENTA
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas"
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={handleClose}>
              <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {successMessage ? (
            <View className="py-4 items-center">
              <View className="mb-2 h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center">
                <LottieView
                  autoPlay
                  loop
                  source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                  style={{ width: 90, height: 90 }}
                />
              </View>
              <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol text-center">
                Contraseña modificada
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-steel max-w-[280px]">
                {successMessage}
              </Text>

              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="mt-6 h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol active:bg-petrol/90"
                onPress={handleClose}>
                <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                  Entendido
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <ScrollView
              className="flex-grow-0"
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
              <View className="gap-3.5 pb-2">
                <Text className="text-xs leading-5 text-steel">
                  Para actualizar tu contraseña, confirma tu contraseña actual y define una nueva que tenga al menos 8 caracteres.
                </Text>

                <TextField
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  editable={!loading}
                  label="Contraseña actual *"
                  onChangeText={(val) => {
                    setCurrentPassword(val);
                    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                  }}
                  placeholder="Tu contraseña actual"
                  rightElement={
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      hitSlop={8}
                      onPress={() => setShowCurrentPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
                      {showCurrentPassword ? (
                        <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      ) : (
                        <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      )}
                    </Pressable>
                  }
                  secureTextEntry={!showCurrentPassword}
                  value={currentPassword}
                />

                <TextField
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  editable={!loading}
                  label="Nueva contraseña *"
                  onChangeText={(val) => {
                    setNewPassword(val);
                    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                  }}
                  placeholder="Mínimo 8 caracteres"
                  rightElement={
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      hitSlop={8}
                      onPress={() => setShowNewPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
                      {showNewPassword ? (
                        <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      ) : (
                        <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      )}
                    </Pressable>
                  }
                  secureTextEntry={!showNewPassword}
                  value={newPassword}
                />

                <TextField
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  editable={!loading}
                  label="Confirmar nueva contraseña *"
                  onChangeText={(val) => {
                    setConfirmPassword(val);
                    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                  }}
                  placeholder="Repite la nueva contraseña"
                  rightElement={
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      hitSlop={8}
                      onPress={() => setShowConfirmPassword((prev) => !prev)}>
                      {showConfirmPassword ? (
                        <EyeOff color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      ) : (
                        <Eye color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
                      )}
                    </Pressable>
                  }
                  secureTextEntry={!showConfirmPassword}
                  value={confirmPassword}
                />

                {errorMessage ? (
                  <View className="rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-2.5">
                    <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                      {errorMessage}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                <View className="mt-2 gap-2">
                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className={`h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol ${
                      loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
                    }`}
                    disabled={loading}
                    onPress={handleChangePassword}>
                    {loading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                    ) : (
                      <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                        Actualizar contraseña
                      </Text>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>

                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className="h-10 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-sky/50 bg-white active:bg-canvas"
                    disabled={loading}
                    onPress={handleClose}>
                    <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-steel">
                      Cancelar
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            </ScrollView>
          )}
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import { Ticket as TicketIcon, X } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import type { CreateTicketDTO, Ticket, TicketPriority } from '@/entities/ticket';
import welcomeBadgeAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/welcome-badge.json';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';

const SUGGESTED_CATEGORIES = [
  'Hardware',
  'Software',
  'Red / Internet',
  'Cuentas / Accesos',
  'Impresoras',
  'Otro',
];

type CreateTicketModalProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess?: (newTicket: Ticket) => void;
};

export function CreateTicketModal({
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: CreateTicketModalProps) {
  const { user } = useSession();

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState<TicketPriority>('medium');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setTitle('');
    setDescription('');
    setCategory('');
    setPriority('medium');
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setIsSuccess(false);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    if (loading) return;
    resetForm();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (loading) return;

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    const trimmedDescription = description.trim();
    const trimmedCategory = category.trim();

    if (!trimmedTitle) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa el título del ticket.');
      return;
    }

    if (trimmedTitle.length < 5) {
      setErrorMessage('El título debe tener al menos 5 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmedCategory) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, indica o selecciona una categoría.');
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmedDescription) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa la descripción del problema.');
      return;
    }

    if (trimmedDescription.length < 10) {
      setErrorMessage('La descripción debe tener al menos 10 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    if (!user?.id) {
      setErrorMessage('No se encontró una sesión activa de usuario. Inicia sesión nuevamente.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const payload: CreateTicketDTO = {
      title: trimmedTitle,
      description: trimmedDescription,
      category: trimmedCategory,
      priority,
      status: 'pending',
      user_id: user.id,
      assigned_to: null,
    };

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('tickets')
        .insert([payload])
        .select()
        .single();

      setLoading(false);

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al insertar ticket en Supabase:', error);
        setErrorMessage(
          error.message || 'Ocurrió un error al crear el ticket. Inténtalo de nuevo.'
        );
        return;
      }

      setIsSuccess(true);
      if (onSuccess && data) {
        onSuccess(data as Ticket);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setLoading(false);
      console.error('Excepción al registrar ticket:', err);
      setErrorMessage(
        err instanceof Error && err.message
          ? err.message
          : 'Error inesperado al conectar con el servidor.'
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-5 py-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={handleClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[460px] max-h-[92%] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Cabecera del modal */}
          <View className="mb-4 flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-sky/30 pb-4">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol/10">
                <TicketIcon color={COLORS.PETROL} size={20} />
              </View>
              <View>
                <Text className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
                  {isSuccess ? 'Ticket creado' : 'Nuevo ticket'}
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-steel">
                  SOPORTE TÉCNICO
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityHint="Cierra el formulario de creación de ticket."
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas active:bg-sky/20"
              disabled={loading}
              hitSlop={8}
              onPress={handleClose}>
              <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {isSuccess ? (
            /* Pantalla de confirmación exitosa con Lottie */
            <View className="items-center py-4">
              <View className="mb-2 h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center">
                <LottieView
                  autoPlay
                  loop
                  source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                  style={{ width: 90, height: 90 }}
                />
              </View>

              <Text className="text-center text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
                ¡Ticket registrado con éxito!
              </Text>

              <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-steel">
                Tu solicitud ha sido guardada con estado Pendiente. El equipo de soporte técnico la revisará en breve.
              </Text>

              <View className="mt-5 w-full rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-canvas p-4">
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-steel">
                  Resumen de la solicitud
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {title.trim()}
                </Text>
                <View className="mt-2 flex-row items-center gap-3">
                  <View className="rounded-full bg-sky/30 px-2.5 py-0.5">
                    <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-steel">
                      {category.trim()}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View className="rounded-full bg-petrol/10 px-2.5 py-0.5">
                    <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-petrol">
                      Prioridad {priority === 'low' ? 'Baja' : priority === 'medium' ? 'Media' : 'Alta'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </View>

              <Pressable
                accessibilityHint="Cierra esta ventana y regresa a tu panel."
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="mt-6 h-13 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol shadow-sm active:bg-petrol/90"
                onPress={handleClose}>
                <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">Entendido</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : (
            /* Formulario de creación */
            <ScrollView
              className="flex-grow-0"
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
              <View className="gap-4 pb-2 pt-1">
                {/* Título */}
                <TextField
                  editable={!loading}
                  label="Título del ticket *"
                  onChangeText={(val) => {
                    setTitle(val);
                    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                  }}
                  placeholder="Ej. Falla al encender equipo o sin internet"
                  value={title}
                />

                {/* Categoría con sugerencias */}
                <View>
                  <TextField
                    editable={!loading}
                    label="Categoría *"
                    onChangeText={(val) => {
                      setCategory(val);
                      if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                    }}
                    placeholder="Ej. Hardware, Software, Redes, Accesos..."
                    value={category}
                  />

                  {/* Sugerencias rápidas de categoría */}
                  <ScrollView
                    className="mt-2"
                    horizontal
                    keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
                    showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
                    <View className="flex-row gap-1.5 py-0.5">
                      {SUGGESTED_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
                        const isSelected = category.toLowerCase() === cat.toLowerCase();
                        return (
                          <Pressable
                            key={cat}
                            accessibilityRole="button"
                            className={`rounded-xl border px-2.5 py-1 ${
                              isSelected
                                ? 'border-petrol bg-petrol/10'
                                : 'border-sky/50 bg-canvas active:bg-sky/20'
                            }`}
                            disabled={loading}
                            onPress={() => {
                              setCategory(cat);
                              if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                            }}>
                            <Text
                              className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                                isSelected ? 'text-petrol' : 'text-steel'
                              }`}>
                              {cat}
                            </Text>
                          </Pressable>
                        );
                      })}
                    </View>
                  </ScrollView>
                </View>

                {/* Prioridad */}
                <View>
                  <Text className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-petrol">
                    Prioridad *
                  </Text>
                  <View className="flex-row gap-2.5">
                    {(['low', 'medium', 'high'] as const).map((p) => {
                      const isSelected = priority === p;
                      const label =
                        p === 'low' ? 'Baja' : p === 'medium' ? 'Media' : 'Alta';
                      const activeBg =
                        p === 'high'
                          ? 'bg-coral'
                          : p === 'medium'
                            ? 'bg-petrol'
                            : 'bg-steel';
                      const borderCol =
                        p === 'high'
                          ? 'border-coral'
                          : p === 'medium'
                            ? 'border-petrol'
                            : 'border-steel';

                      return (
                        <Pressable
                          key={p}
                          accessibilityRole="button"
                          className={`h-11 flex-1 flex-row items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border ${
                            isSelected
                              ? `${activeBg} ${borderCol}`
                              : 'border-sky/60 bg-white active:bg-canvas'
                          }`}
                          disabled={loading}
                          onPress={() => {
                            setPriority(p);
                            if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                          }}>
                          <Text
                            className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                              isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-petrol'
                            }`}>
                            {label}
                          </Text>
                        </Pressable>
                      );
                    })}
                  </View>
                </View>

                {/* Descripción del problema con contador en tiempo real */}
                <View>
                  <View className="mb-2 flex-row items-center justify-between">
                    <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-petrol">
                      Descripción del problema *
                    </Text>
                    <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-steel">
                      {description.length} caracteres (mín. 10)
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <TextInput
                    className="min-h-[105px] rounded-2xl border border-sky bg-white p-4 text-[15px] text-petrol"
                    editable={!loading}
                    multiline
                    numberOfLines={4}
                    onChangeText={(val) => {
                      setDescription(val);
                      if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                    }}
                    placeholder="Describe detalladamente el problema, mensajes de error observados y el área de trabajo afectada..."
                    placeholderTextColor={COLORS.STEEL}
                    textAlignVertical="top"
                    value={description}
                  />
                </View>

                {/* Mensaje de error de validación o del servidor */}
                {errorMessage ? (
                  <View className="rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
                    <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                      {errorMessage}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                {/* Botones de acción */}
                <View className="mt-2 gap-2.5">
                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityHint="Guarda el ticket en el sistema."
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className={`h-13 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol shadow-sm ${
                      loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
                    }`}
                    disabled={loading}
                    onPress={handleSave}>
                    {loading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" />
                    ) : (
                      <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">
                        Guardar ticket
                      </Text>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>

                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityHint="Descarta el formulario y regresa al panel."
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className={`h-11 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-sky/50 bg-white active:bg-canvas ${
                      loading ? 'opacity-50' : ''
                    }`}
                    disabled={loading}
                    onPress={handleClose}>
                    <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-steel">
                      Cancelar
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              </View>
            </ScrollView>
          )}
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Modal, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Trash2 } from 'lucide-react-native';

import type { Ticket } from '@/entities/ticket';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

type DeleteTicketModalProps = {
  ticket: Ticket | null;
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (deletedTicketId: string) => void;
};

export function DeleteTicketModal({
  ticket,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: DeleteTicketModalProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!ticket) return null;

  const isPending = ticket.status === 'pending';

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!isPending) {
      setErrorMessage('Solo se pueden eliminar tickets en estado pendiente.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('tickets')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', ticket.id);

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al eliminar ticket:', error);
        setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo eliminar el ticket.');
        return;
      }

      onSuccess(ticket.id);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al eliminar ticket:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Error al conectar con el servidor.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={onClose}
        />

        <View className="w-full max-w-[380px] items-center rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-xl">
          <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-coral/10">
            <Trash2 color={COLORS.CORAL} size={24} />
          </View>

          <Text className="mt-4 text-center text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
            ¿Eliminar ticket?
          </Text>

          <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-steel">
            ¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar «{ticket.title}»? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
          </Text>

          {!isPending ? (
            <View className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
              <Text className="text-center text-xs font-semibold text-coral">
                Solo se pueden eliminar tickets en estado pendiente.
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {errorMessage ? (
            <View className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3">
              <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                {errorMessage}
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          <View className="mt-6 w-full gap-3">
            {isPending ? (
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className={`h-13 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-coral shadow-sm ${
                  loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:opacity-90'
                }`}
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={handleDelete}>
                {loading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">
                    Sí, eliminar ticket
                  </Text>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-11 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-sky/50 bg-white"
              disabled={loading}
              onPress={onClose}>
              <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-steel">Cancelar</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}
