import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { Edit3, X } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { TicketPriorityBadge, type Ticket } from '@/entities/ticket';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';

type EditTicketModalProps = {
  ticket: Ticket | null;
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (updated: Ticket) => void;
};

function EditTicketFormContent({
  ticket,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  ticket: Ticket;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (updated: Ticket) => void;
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(ticket.title || '');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(ticket.description || '');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(ticket.category || '');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isPending = ticket.status === 'pending';

  const handleSave = async () => {
    // 7. No permitir editar si el ticket no está pendiente
    if (!isPending) {
      setErrorMessage('Solo se pueden editar tickets en estado pendiente.');
      return;
    }

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    const trimmedDescription = description.trim();
    const trimmedCategory = category.trim();

    if (!trimmedTitle || trimmedTitle.length < 5) {
      setErrorMessage('El título debe tener al menos 5 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmedCategory) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, indica la categoría.');
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmedDescription || trimmedDescription.length < 10) {
      setErrorMessage('La descripción debe tener al menos 10 caracteres.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      // 1. Llamada RPC con nombres exactos de parámetros definidos en Supabase
      // 2. Envío de valores validados del formulario
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('requester_update_pending_ticket', {
        p_ticket_id: ticket.id,
        p_title: trimmedTitle,
        p_description: trimmedDescription,
        p_category: trimmedCategory,
      });

      // 5. Capturar el error real devuelto por Supabase para depurar
      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al actualizar ticket mediante RPC requester_update_pending_ticket:', error);
        setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo actualizar el ticket.');
        return;
      }

      // 3 y 4. Comprobar resultado booleano: data === false NO es éxito
      if (data === false) {
        setErrorMessage('No se pudo actualizar el ticket. Es posible que ya no esté pendiente o no tengas permisos para modificarlo.');
        return;
      }

      // 6. Al completarse exitosamente, actualizar la interfaz
      const updated: Ticket = {
        ...ticket,
        title: trimmedTitle,
        description: trimmedDescription,
        category: trimmedCategory,
      };

      onSuccess(updated);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al actualizar ticket:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Error de conexión al guardar los cambios.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="w-full max-w-[460px] max-h-[92%] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
      {/* Cabecera */}
      <View className="mb-4 flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-sky/30 pb-3">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
          <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
            <Edit3 color={COLORS.PETROL} size={18} />
          </View>
          <View>
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
              Editar ticket
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-steel">
              SOLICITUD PENDIENTE
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={onClose}>
          <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {!isPending ? (
        <View className="py-6 items-center">
          <Text className="text-center text-sm font-semibold text-coral">
            Este ticket ya no se encuentra en estado pendiente y no puede ser modificado.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <ScrollView
          className="flex-grow-0"
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
          <View className="gap-3.5 pb-2">
            <TextField
              editable={!loading}
              label="Título *"
              onChangeText={(val) => {
                setTitle(val);
                if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              value={title}
            />

            <TextField
              editable={!loading}
              label="Categoría *"
              onChangeText={(val) => {
                setCategory(val);
                if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              value={category}
            />

            <View>
              <Text className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-steel">
                Prioridad
              </Text>
              <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-canvas px-3.5 py-2.5">
                <TicketPriorityBadge priority={ticket.priority} />
                <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel">
                  Asignada al registrar el ticket
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View>
              <View className="mb-2 flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-petrol">
                  Descripción del problema *
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-steel">
                  {description.length} caracteres (mín. 10)
                </Text>
              </View>
              <TextInput
                className="min-h-[95px] rounded-2xl border border-sky bg-white p-3.5 text-xs text-petrol"
                editable={!loading}
                multiline
                numberOfLines={4}
                onChangeText={(val) => {
                  setDescription(val);
                  if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
                }}
                placeholderTextColor={COLORS.STEEL}
                textAlignVertical="top"
                value={description}
              />
            </View>

            {errorMessage ? (
              <View className="rounded-xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-2.5">
                <Text className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                  {errorMessage}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <View className="mt-2 gap-2">
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className={`h-12 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol ${
                  loading ? 'opacity-70' : 'active:bg-petrol/90'
                }`}
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={handleSave}>
                {loading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                    Guardar cambios
                  </Text>
                )}
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                className="h-10 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-sky/50 bg-white"
                disabled={loading}
                onPress={onClose}>
                <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-steel">
                  Cancelar
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

export function EditTicketModal({
  ticket,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: EditTicketModalProps) {
  if (!visible || !ticket) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-5 py-6">
        <Pressable
          accessibilityLabel="Cerrar modal"
          className="absolute inset-0"
          onPress={onClose}
        />

        <EditTicketFormContent
          key={`${ticket.id}-${ticket.updated_at || ticket.created_at}`}
          onClose={onClose}
          onSuccess={onSuccess}
          ticket={ticket}
        />
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Lock,
  MessageSquare,
  Send,
  User,
} from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import type { Ticket, TicketObservation } from '@/entities/ticket';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

type TicketObservationsListProps = {
  ticketId?: string;
  ticket?: Ticket;
};

function formatObservationDate(dateStr: string): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr;
    return d.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'short',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

export function TicketObservationsList({
  ticketId: propTicketId,
  ticket,
}: TicketObservationsListProps) {
  const currentTicketId = ticket?.id || propTicketId || '';
  const { user, profile } = useSession();
  const [observations, setObservations] = useState<TicketObservation[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(Boolean(currentTicketId));
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Determinación estricta de permisos según reglas de negocio y RLS:
  // - Solicitante: solo en sus propios tickets en estado pending o in_progress.
  // - Soporte: solo en tickets asignados a él en estado in_progress.
  // - Ni solicitante ni soporte pueden agregar observaciones en tickets resolved o cancelled.
  const userRole = profile?.role;
  const isRequesterOwner = userRole === 'requester' && ticket?.user_id === user?.id;
  const isAssignedSupport = userRole === 'support' && ticket?.assigned_to === user?.id;

  let canAddObservation = false;
  let blockReason: string | null = null;

  if (ticket) {
    if (ticket.status === 'resolved') {
      blockReason = 'Este ticket ha sido resuelto y no admite nuevas observaciones.';
    } else if (ticket.status === 'cancelled') {
      blockReason = 'Este ticket ha sido cancelado y no admite nuevas observaciones.';
    } else if (userRole === 'requester') {
      if (isRequesterOwner && (ticket.status === 'pending' || ticket.status === 'in_progress')) {
        canAddObservation = true;
      } else if (!isRequesterOwner) {
        blockReason = 'Solo el solicitante que creó este ticket puede registrar observaciones.';
      }
    } else if (userRole === 'support') {
      if (isAssignedSupport && ticket.status === 'in_progress') {
        canAddObservation = true;
      } else if (ticket.status === 'pending') {
        blockReason = 'Debes tomar el ticket antes de poder registrar observaciones técnicas.';
      } else {
        blockReason = 'Solo el especialista técnico asignado a este ticket puede agregar observaciones.';
      }
    } else if (userRole === 'admin') {
      blockReason = 'El rol de administrador no atiende incidencias ni registra observaciones.';
    }
  } else {
    // Si no se proporcionó el objeto completo de ticket, permitir condicionado a sesión
    canAddObservation = !!user?.id;
  }

  const reloadObservations = async () => {
    if (!currentTicketId) return;
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('ticket_observations')
      .select('id, ticket_id, user_id, message, created_at, profiles(full_name, email, role)')
      .eq('ticket_id', currentTicketId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && data) {
      setObservations(data as unknown as TicketObservation[]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentTicketId) {
      return;
    }
    let isMounted = true;

    supabase
      .from('ticket_observations')
      .select('id, ticket_id, user_id, message, created_at, profiles(full_name, email, role)')
      .eq('ticket_id', currentTicketId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
      .then(({ data, error }) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (error) {
          console.warn('Error al cargar observaciones:', error.message);
        } else if (data) {
          setObservations(data as unknown as TicketObservation[]);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [currentTicketId]);

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (sending) return;

    if (!canAddObservation) {
      setErrorMessage(blockReason || 'No tienes permisos para agregar observaciones a este ticket.');
      return;
    }

    const trimmed = newMessage.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, ingresa una observación.');
      return;
    }

    if (!user?.id) {
      setErrorMessage('Debes iniciar sesión para agregar observaciones.');
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('ticket_observations')
        .insert([
          {
            ticket_id: currentTicketId,
            user_id: user.id,
            message: trimmed,
          },
        ]);

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al agregar observación:', error);
        if (error.code === '42501') {
          setErrorMessage('No tienes permisos de seguridad para agregar observaciones a este ticket.');
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(error.message || 'No se pudo guardar la observación.');
        }
        return;
      }

      setNewMessage('');
      await reloadObservations();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al enviar observación:', err);
      setErrorMessage('Error de conexión al enviar la observación.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="mt-4">
      {/* Título de la sección */}
      <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
        <MessageSquare color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
        <Text className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wider text-steel">
          OBSERVACIONES Y NOTAS ({observations.length})
        </Text>
      </View>

      {/* Lista de observaciones / Historial */}
      {loading ? (
        <View className="py-6 items-center">
          <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="small" />
        </View>
      ) : observations.length === 0 ? (
        <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-canvas p-4 text-center items-center">
          <Text className="text-xs text-steel">
            Aún no hay observaciones registradas en este ticket.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View className="gap-2.5">
          {observations.map((obs) => {
            const isCurrentUser = obs.user_id === user?.id;
            const authorName =
              obs.profiles?.full_name ||
              (isCurrentUser ? 'Tú' : 'Usuario');
            const roleLabel =
              obs.profiles?.role === 'support'
                ? 'Soporte'
                : obs.profiles?.role === 'admin'
                  ? 'Admin'
                  : 'Solicitante';

            return (
              <View
                key={obs.id}
                className={`rounded-2xl border p-3.5 ${
                  isCurrentUser
                    ? 'border-sky/50 bg-sky/10'
                    : 'border-sky/30 bg-canvas'
                }`}>
                <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-sky/20">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
                    <User color={COLORS.STEEL} size={12} />
                    <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-petrol">
                      {authorName}
                    </Text>
                    <View className="rounded bg-sky/30 px-1.5 py-0.2">
                      <Text className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-steel">
                        {roleLabel}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <Text className="text-[10px] text-steel">
                    {formatObservationDate(obs.created_at)}
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <Text className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-petrol">
                  {obs.message}
                </Text>
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Formulario para agregar nueva observación o mensaje informativo cuando está bloqueado */}
      {canAddObservation ? (
        <View className="mt-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-3">
          <Text className="mb-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-steel">
            Agregar observación
          </Text>
          <TextInput
            className="min-h-[64px] rounded-xl border border-sky/50 bg-canvas p-2.5 text-xs text-petrol"
            editable={!sending}
            multiline
            numberOfLines={2}
            onChangeText={(val) => {
              setNewMessage(val);
              if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage(null);
            }}
            placeholder="Escribe un comentario, aclaración o actualización técnica..."
            placeholderTextColor={COLORS.STEEL}
            textAlignVertical="top"
            value={newMessage}
          />

          {errorMessage ? (
            <Text className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-coral">
              {errorMessage}
            </Text>
          ) : null}

          <Pressable
            accessibilityHint="Envía la observación al historial del ticket."
            accessibilityRole="button"
            className={`mt-2.5 h-10 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-petrol active:bg-petrol/90 ${
              sending ? 'opacity-70' : ''
            }`}
            disabled={sending}
            onPress={handleSend}>
            {sending ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Send color="#FFFFFF" size={14} />
                <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                  Enviar observación
                </Text>
              </>
            )}
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View className="mt-3.5 flex-row items-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-canvas p-3.5">
          {ticket?.status === 'resolved' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
          ) : ticket?.status === 'cancelled' ? (
            <AlertCircle color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
          ) : (
            <Lock color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
          )}
          <Text className="flex-1 text-xs text-steel leading-relaxed">
            {blockReason || 'No es posible agregar nuevas observaciones en este ticket.'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import {
  Headphones,
  Search,
  Shield,
  Ticket as TicketIcon,
  UserCog,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession, type Profile, type UserRole } from '@/entities/session';
import { ChangeRoleModal } from '@/features/admin-change-role';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { AppLogo } from '@/shared/ui/app-logo';
import { TextField } from '@/shared/ui/text-field';
import { AppMenu, AppMenuButton } from '@/widgets/app-menu';
import { WelcomeModal } from '@/widgets/welcome-modal';

function getContextualGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) {
    return 'Buenos días';
  }
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 19) {
    return 'Buenas tardes';
  }
  return 'Buenas noches';
}

type AdminPageProps = {
  welcome?: string;
};

export function AdminPage({ welcome: welcomeProp }: AdminPageProps = {}) {
  const { user, profile, pendingWelcome, consumeWelcome } = useSession();

  const [usersList, setUsersList] = useState<Profile[]>([]);
  const [totalTicketsCount, setTotalTicketsCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const [selectedUserForRole, setSelectedUserForRole] = useState<Profile | null>(null);
  const [isRoleModalVisible, setIsRoleModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isMenuVisible, setIsMenuVisible] = useState(false);

  const routeParams = useLocalSearchParams<{ welcome?: string }>();
  const isFromPropOrRoute = (welcomeProp ?? routeParams.welcome) === '1';

  const [isWelcomeModalVisible, setIsWelcomeModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const welcomeHandledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const shouldShow = pendingWelcome || isFromPropOrRoute;
    if (shouldShow && !welcomeHandledRef.current) {
      welcomeHandledRef.current = true;
      consumeWelcome();
      setIsWelcomeModalVisible(true);
    }
  }, [pendingWelcome, isFromPropOrRoute, consumeWelcome]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const fetchTicketCount = async (): Promise<number> => {
        try {
          // Intento prioritario: RPC segura admin_get_total_tickets (SECURITY DEFINER)
          const { data: rpcCount, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('admin_get_total_tickets');
          if (!rpcError && typeof rpcCount === 'number') {
            return rpcCount;
          }
          if (rpcError) {
            console.info('RPC admin_get_total_tickets no disponible o error:', rpcError.message);
          }
        } catch {
          // Continuar con fallback
        }

        // Fallback: consulta directa a public.tickets con conteo exacto
        const { count, error: countError } = await supabase
          .from('tickets')
          .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });

        if (countError) {
          console.warn('Advertencia al consultar conteo de tickets en public.tickets:', countError.message);
          return 0;
        }

        return typeof count === 'number' ? count : 0;
      };

      const [profilesRes, ticketCount] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id, full_name, email, role')
          .order('full_name', { ascending: true }),
        fetchTicketCount(),
      ]);

      if (profilesRes.data) {
        setUsersList(profilesRes.data as Profile[]);
      } else if (profilesRes.error) {
        console.warn('Error al cargar perfiles en admin:', profilesRes.error.message);
      }

      setTotalTicketsCount(ticketCount);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Excepción al cargar datos de administración:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('id, full_name, email, role')
        .order('full_name', { ascending: true }),
      supabase
        .rpc('admin_get_total_tickets')
        .then(
          ({ data: rpcCount, error: rpcError }) => {
            if (!rpcError && typeof rpcCount === 'number') {
              return rpcCount;
            }
            return supabase
              .from('tickets')
              .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
              .then(({ count }) => (typeof count === 'number' ? count : 0));
          },
          () => {
            return supabase
              .from('tickets')
              .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
              .then(({ count }) => (typeof count === 'number' ? count : 0));
          }
        ),
    ]).then(([profilesRes, ticketCount]) => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      if (profilesRes.data) {
        setUsersList(profilesRes.data as Profile[]);
      }
      setTotalTicketsCount(ticketCount);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  const greeting = getContextualGreeting();
  const displayName = profile?.full_name?.trim() || user?.user_metadata?.full_name?.trim() || user?.email || 'Administrador';
  const userInitial = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  // Contadores
  const techniciansCount = usersList.filter((u) => u.role === 'support').length;
  const totalUsersCount = usersList.length;

  // Filtrado de usuarios para búsqueda rápida
  const filteredUsers = usersList.filter((u) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) return true;
    const nameMatch = u.full_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const emailMatch = u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const roleMatch = u.role?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    return nameMatch || emailMatch || roleMatch;
  });

  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-canvas" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <ScrollView
        className="flex-1"
        contentContainerClassName="flex-grow"
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            colors={[COLORS.PETROL]}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            refreshing={refreshing}
            tintColor={COLORS.PETROL}
          />
        }>
        <View className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[440px] flex-1 px-6 pb-8">
          {/* Barra superior */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-6 pt-3">
            <AppLogo />

            {/* Píldora de rol y Menú */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky/60 bg-white px-3 py-1.5">
                <View className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-steel" />
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[1.2px] text-steel">
                  ADMINISTRADOR
                </Text>
              </View>

              <AppMenuButton onPress={() => setIsMenuVisible(true)} />
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Tarjeta de bienvenida y perfil */}
          <View className="mt-2 rounded-3xl border border-sky/50 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-4">
              <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol/10">
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{userInitial}</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
                  {greeting.toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {displayName}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {user?.email}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Resumen global del sistema */}
          <View className="mt-6">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
              MÉTRICAS GLOBALES
            </Text>

            <View className="flex-row gap-3">
              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                  <TicketIcon color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{totalTicketsCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Total tickets</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-coral/10">
                  <Headphones color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{techniciansCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Técnicos</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-sky/30">
                  <Users color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{totalUsersCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Usuarios</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Sección de Gestión de Usuarios y Roles */}
          <View className="mt-7">
            <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
                <UserCog color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
                  GESTIÓN DE USUARIOS Y ROLES ({usersList.length})
                </Text>
              </View>
              {loading ? <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="small" /> : null}
            </View>

            {/* Barra de búsqueda rápida estandarizada con TextField */}
            <View className="mb-3">
              <TextField
                leftElement={<Search color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />}
                onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
                placeholder="Buscar por nombre, correo o rol..."
                value={searchQuery}
                variant="compact"
              />
            </View>

            {loading && usersList.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="py-12 items-center justify-center">
                <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="large" />
                <Text className="mt-3 text-xs text-steel">Cargando directorio de usuarios...</Text>
              </View>
            ) : filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 items-center shadow-sm">
                <Search color={COLORS.STEEL} size={22} />
                <Text className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-petrol">Sin resultados</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-center text-[11px] text-steel">
                  No se encontraron usuarios que coincidan con «{searchQuery}».
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              <View className="gap-2.5">
                {filteredUsers.map((u) => {
                  const isCurrentUser = u.id === user?.id;
                  const isAdmin = u.role === 'admin';
                  const isSupport = u.role === 'support';
                  const initial = (u.full_name?.charAt(0) || u.email?.charAt(0) || 'U').toUpperCase();

                  const roleBadgeBg = isAdmin
                    ? 'bg-petrol text-white'
                    : isSupport
                      ? 'bg-coral/15 text-coral border border-coral/30'
                      : 'bg-sky/30 text-steel border border-sky/50';

                  const roleLabel = isAdmin
                    ? 'ADMINISTRADOR'
                    : isSupport
                      ? 'SOPORTE'
                      : 'SOLICITANTE';

                  return (
                    <View
                      key={u.id}
                      className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm">
                      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
                        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 flex-1 mr-2">
                          <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-petrol">{initial}</Text>
                          </View>

                          <View className="flex-1">
                            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                                {u.full_name || 'Sin nombre registrado'}
                              </Text>
                              {isCurrentUser ? (
                                <View className="rounded bg-steel/20 px-1.5 py-0.2">
                                  <Text className="text-[9px] font-semibold text-steel">
                                    TÚ
                                  </Text>
                                </View>
                              ) : null}
                            </View>
                            <Text className="text-xs text-steel mt-0.5" numberOfLines={1}>
                              {u.email}
                            </Text>
                          </View>
                        </View>

                        {/* Píldora de rol actual */}
                        <View className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 ${roleBadgeBg}`}>
                          <Text className="text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wider">
                            {roleLabel}
                          </Text>
                        </View>
                      </View>

                      {/* Botón de acción para cambiar rol */}
                      {!isCurrentUser && !isAdmin ? (
                        <View className="mt-2.5 border-t border-sky/15 pt-2 flex-row justify-end items-center">
                          <Pressable
                            accessibilityRole="button"
                            className="h-7 px-3 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-petrol/30 bg-petrol/5 active:bg-petrol/15"
                            onPress={() => {
                              setSelectedUserForRole(u);
                              setIsRoleModalVisible(true);
                            }}>
                            <Shield color={COLORS.PETROL} size={11} />
                            <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-petrol">
                              Cambiar a {isSupport ? 'Solicitante' : 'Soporte'}
                            </Text>
                          </Pressable>
                        </View>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Pie de página */}
          <View className="mt-auto items-center pt-8">
            <Text className="text-xs text-steel">TickDesk · Soporte técnico · EPN</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Modal para cambiar rol de usuario */}
      <ChangeRoleModal
        targetUser={selectedUserForRole}
        visible={isRoleModalVisible}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsRoleModalVisible(false);
          setSelectedUserForRole(null);
        }}
        onSuccess={(userId, newRole: UserRole) => {
          setUsersList((prev) =>
            prev.map((u) => (u.id === userId ? { ...u, role: newRole } : u))
          );
        }}
      />

      {/* Menú lateral hamburguesa reutilizable */}
      <AppMenu
        visible={isMenuVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsMenuVisible(false)}
      />

      {/* Ventana emergente (modal) de bienvenida animada con el técnico de soporte */}
      <WelcomeModal
        visible={isWelcomeModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsWelcomeModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { CheckCircle2, Clock, LogOut, Ticket } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import { SignOutConfirmModal } from '@/features/auth';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { AppLogo } from '@/shared/ui/app-logo';
import { WelcomeModal } from '@/widgets/welcome-modal';

function getContextualGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) {
    return 'Buenos días';
  }
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 19) {
    return 'Buenas tardes';
  }
  return 'Buenas noches';
}

type DashboardPageProps = {
  welcome?: string;
};

export function DashboardPage({ welcome: welcomeProp }: DashboardPageProps = {}) {
  const { user, pendingWelcome, consumeWelcome } = useSession();
  const [isSignOutModalVisible, setIsSignOutModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const routeParams = useLocalSearchParams<{ welcome?: string }>();
  const isFromPropOrRoute = (welcomeProp ?? routeParams.welcome) === '1';

  // Estado para controlar la visibilidad del modal de bienvenida
  const [isWelcomeModalVisible, setIsWelcomeModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const welcomeHandledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const shouldShow = pendingWelcome || isFromPropOrRoute;
    if (shouldShow && !welcomeHandledRef.current) {
      welcomeHandledRef.current = true;
      consumeWelcome();
      setIsWelcomeModalVisible(true);
    }
  }, [pendingWelcome, isFromPropOrRoute, consumeWelcome]);

  const greeting = getContextualGreeting();

  const displayName =
    typeof user?.user_metadata?.full_name === 'string' && user.user_metadata.full_name.trim()
      ? user.user_metadata.full_name.trim()
      : user?.email || 'Usuario';

  const userInitial = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-canvas" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <ScrollView
        className="flex-1"
        contentContainerClassName="flex-grow"
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
        <View className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[440px] flex-1 px-6 pb-8">
          {/* Barra superior */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-6 pt-3">
            <AppLogo />

            {/* Píldora de estado alineada a la paleta TickDesk (sin verde no corporativo) */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky/60 bg-white px-3 py-1.5">
              <View className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-steel" />
              <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[1.2px] text-steel">
                CONECTADO
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Tarjeta de bienvenida y perfil */}
          <View className="mt-2 rounded-3xl border border-sky/50 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-4">
              {/* Avatar e información habitual en el Dashboard */}
              <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol/10">
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{userInitial}</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
                  {greeting.toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {displayName}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {user?.email}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Resumen de tickets provisional con tokens de color de TickDesk */}
          <View className="mt-6">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
              RESUMEN DE ACTIVIDAD
            </Text>

            <View className="flex-row gap-3">
              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                  <Ticket color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">0</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Abiertos</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-coral/10">
                  <Clock color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">0</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">En proceso</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-sky/30">
                  <CheckCircle2 color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">0</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Resueltos</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Nota informativa de Dashboard provisional */}
          <View className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-sky/15 p-4">
            <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">
              Panel de control provisional
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-steel">
              Tu sesión se encuentra activa y persistida de forma segura. La creación y el seguimiento detallado de tickets se habilitarán en la siguiente etapa del proyecto.
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* Botón de cierre de sesión con confirmación */}
          <Pressable
            accessibilityHint="Abre la ventana para confirmar el cierre de sesión."
            accessibilityRole="button"
            className="mt-8 h-14 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-coral/30 bg-white active:bg-coral/5"
            onPress={() => setIsSignOutModalVisible(true)}>
            <LogOut color={COLORS.CORAL} size={18} />
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-coral">Cerrar sesión</Text>
          </Pressable>

          {/* Pie de página */}
          <View className="mt-auto items-center pt-8">
            <Text className="text-xs text-steel">TickDesk · Soporte técnico · EPN</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Modal de confirmación antes de cerrar sesión */}
      <SignOutConfirmModal
        visible={isSignOutModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsSignOutModalVisible(false)}
      />

      {/* Ventana emergente (modal) de bienvenida animada con el técnico de soporte */}
      <WelcomeModal
        visible={isWelcomeModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsWelcomeModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Plus,
  Ticket as TicketIcon,
} from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import { TicketCard, type Ticket } from '@/entities/ticket';
import { CreateTicketModal } from '@/features/create-ticket';
import welcomeBadgeAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/welcome-badge.json';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { AppLogo } from '@/shared/ui/app-logo';
import { AppMenu, AppMenuButton } from '@/widgets/app-menu';
import { TicketDetailModal } from '@/widgets/ticket-detail-modal';
import { WelcomeModal } from '@/widgets/welcome-modal';

function getContextualGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) {
    return 'Buenos días';
  }
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 19) {
    return 'Buenas tardes';
  }
  return 'Buenas noches';
}

type RequesterPageProps = {
  welcome?: string;
};

export function RequesterPage({ welcome: welcomeProp }: RequesterPageProps = {}) {
  const { user, profile, pendingWelcome, consumeWelcome } = useSession();
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<Ticket[]>([]);
  const [loadingTickets, setLoadingTickets] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [selectedTicket, setSelectedTicket] = useState<Ticket | null>(null);
  const [isDetailModalVisible, setIsDetailModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isMenuVisible, setIsMenuVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isCreateModalVisible, setIsCreateModalVisible] = useState(false);

  const routeParams = useLocalSearchParams<{ welcome?: string }>();
  const isFromPropOrRoute = (welcomeProp ?? routeParams.welcome) === '1';

  const [isWelcomeModalVisible, setIsWelcomeModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const welcomeHandledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const shouldShow = pendingWelcome || isFromPropOrRoute;
    if (shouldShow && !welcomeHandledRef.current) {
      welcomeHandledRef.current = true;
      consumeWelcome();
      setIsWelcomeModalVisible(true);
    }
  }, [pendingWelcome, isFromPropOrRoute, consumeWelcome]);

  const loadTickets = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('tickets')
        .select('*, assigned_profile:profiles!assigned_to(full_name, email)')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && data) {
        setTickets(data as unknown as Ticket[]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Excepción al consultar tickets:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingTickets(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (user?.id) {
      supabase
        .from('tickets')
        .select('*, assigned_profile:profiles!assigned_to(full_name, email)')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .then(({ data, error }) => {
          if (!isMounted) return;
          if (!error && data) {
            setTickets(data as unknown as Ticket[]);
          }
          setLoadingTickets(false);
        });
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [user]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadTickets();
  }, [loadTickets]);

  const greeting = getContextualGreeting();
  const displayName = profile?.full_name?.trim() || user?.user_metadata?.full_name?.trim() || user?.email || 'Solicitante';
  const userInitial = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const pendingCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'pending').length;
  const inProgressCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'in_progress').length;
  const resolvedCount = tickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'resolved').length;

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'resolved'>('all');

  const filteredTickets = useMemo(() => {
    if (statusFilter === 'all') return tickets;
    return tickets.filter((t) => t.status === statusFilter);
  }, [tickets, statusFilter]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-canvas" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <ScrollView
        className="flex-1"
        contentContainerClassName="flex-grow"
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            colors={[COLORS.PETROL]}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            refreshing={refreshing}
            tintColor={COLORS.PETROL}
          />
        }>
        <View className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[440px] flex-1 px-6 pb-8">
          {/* Barra superior */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-6 pt-3">
            <AppLogo />

            {/* Píldora de rol y Menú de opciones */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky/60 bg-white px-3 py-1.5">
                <View className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-steel" />
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[1.2px] text-steel">
                  SOLICITANTE
                </Text>
              </View>

              <AppMenuButton onPress={() => setIsMenuVisible(true)} />
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Tarjeta de bienvenida y perfil */}
          <View className="mt-2 rounded-3xl border border-sky/50 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-4">
              <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol/10">
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{userInitial}</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
                  {greeting.toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {displayName}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {user?.email}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Botón principal de acción: Crear nuevo ticket */}
          <Pressable
            accessibilityHint="Abre el formulario para registrar un nuevo ticket de soporte técnico."
            accessibilityRole="button"
            className="mt-5 h-14 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-petrol shadow-sm active:bg-petrol/90"
            onPress={() => setIsCreateModalVisible(true)}>
            <Plus color="#FFFFFF" size={20} />
            <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">Crear nuevo ticket</Text>
          </Pressable>

          {/* Resumen de tickets del solicitante */}
          <View className="mt-6">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
              RESUMEN DE MIS TICKETS
            </Text>

            <View className="flex-row gap-3">
              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                  <TicketIcon color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{pendingCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Abiertos</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-coral/10">
                  <Clock color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{inProgressCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">En proceso</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-petrol/20 bg-petrol/5 p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/15">
                  <CheckCircle2 color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{resolvedCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">Resueltos</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Listado de tickets con filtros rápidos */}
          <View className="mt-7">
            <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
                HISTORIAL DE INCIDENCIAS ({tickets.length})
              </Text>
              {loadingTickets ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="small" />
              ) : null}
            </View>

            {/* Píldoras de filtro rápido por estado */}
            <View className="mb-3 flex-row gap-2">
              <Pressable
                className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 border ${
                  statusFilter === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-petrol border-petrol'
                    : 'bg-white border-sky/60 active:bg-canvas'
                }`}
                onPress={() => setStatusFilter('all')}>
                <Text
                  className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                    statusFilter === 'all' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                  }`}>
                  Todos ({tickets.length})
                </Text>
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 border ${
                  statusFilter === 'pending'
                    ? 'bg-petrol border-petrol'
                    : 'bg-white border-sky/60 active:bg-canvas'
                }`}
                onPress={() => setStatusFilter('pending')}>
                <Text
                  className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                    statusFilter === 'pending' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                  }`}>
                  Abiertos ({pendingCount})
                </Text>
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 border ${
                  statusFilter === 'in_progress'
                    ? 'bg-petrol border-petrol'
                    : 'bg-white border-sky/60 active:bg-canvas'
                }`}
                onPress={() => setStatusFilter('in_progress')}>
                <Text
                  className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                    statusFilter === 'in_progress' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                  }`}>
                  En proceso ({inProgressCount})
                </Text>
              </Pressable>

              <Pressable
                className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 border ${
                  statusFilter === 'resolved'
                    ? 'bg-petrol border-petrol'
                    : 'bg-white border-sky/60 active:bg-canvas'
                }`}
                onPress={() => setStatusFilter('resolved')}>
                <Text
                  className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                    statusFilter === 'resolved' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                  }`}>
                  Resueltos ({resolvedCount})
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {loadingTickets && tickets.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="py-12 items-center justify-center">
                <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="large" />
                <Text className="mt-3 text-xs text-steel">Cargando tus solicitudes...</Text>
              </View>
            ) : tickets.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-7 items-center text-center shadow-sm">
                <View className="mb-2 h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center">
                  <LottieView
                    autoPlay
                    loop
                    source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                    style={{ width: 90, height: 90 }}
                  />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
                  No tienes tickets registrados
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-steel max-w-[260px]">
                  Crea tu primera solicitud para recibir asistencia del equipo de soporte técnico.
                </Text>
                <Pressable
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  className="mt-5 h-11 px-5 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-petrol active:bg-petrol/90"
                  onPress={() => setIsCreateModalVisible(true)}>
                  <Plus color="#FFFFFF" size={16} />
                  <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Crear primer ticket</Text>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            ) : filteredTickets.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-white p-6 items-center">
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">
                  No hay tickets que coincidan con el filtro seleccionado.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              filteredTickets.map((t) => (
                <TicketCard
                  key={t.id}
                  ticket={t}
                  onPress={(clicked) => {
                    setSelectedTicket(clicked);
                    setIsDetailModalVisible(true);
                  }}
                />
              ))
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Pie de página */}
          <View className="mt-auto items-center pt-8">
            <Text className="text-xs text-steel">TickDesk · Soporte técnico · EPN</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Modal para crear un nuevo ticket */}
      <CreateTicketModal
        visible={isCreateModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsCreateModalVisible(false)}
        onSuccess={(newTicket) => {
          setTickets((prev) => [newTicket, ...prev]);
        }}
      />

      {/* Modal de detalle de ticket (con edición, eliminación y observaciones) */}
      <TicketDetailModal
        ticket={selectedTicket}
        visible={isDetailModalVisible}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsDetailModalVisible(false);
          setSelectedTicket(null);
        }}
        onTicketUpdated={(updated) => {
          setTickets((prev) =>
            prev.map((t) => (t.id === updated.id ? updated : t))
          );
        }}
        onTicketDeleted={(deletedId) => {
          setTickets((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== deletedId));
        }}
      />

      {/* Menú lateral de la aplicación (centraliza opciones de cuenta) */}
      <AppMenu
        visible={isMenuVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsMenuVisible(false)}
      />

      {/* Ventana emergente (modal) de bienvenida animada con el técnico de soporte */}
      <WelcomeModal
        visible={isWelcomeModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsWelcomeModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Headphones,
  Ticket as TicketIcon,
  UserCheck,
} from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import { TicketCard, type Ticket } from '@/entities/ticket';
import welcomeBadgeAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/welcome-badge.json';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';
import { AppLogo } from '@/shared/ui/app-logo';
import { AppMenu, AppMenuButton } from '@/widgets/app-menu';
import { TicketDetailModal } from '@/widgets/ticket-detail-modal';
import { WelcomeModal } from '@/widgets/welcome-modal';

function getContextualGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) {
    return 'Buenos días';
  }
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 19) {
    return 'Buenas tardes';
  }
  return 'Buenas noches';
}

type SupportPageProps = {
  welcome?: string;
};

export function SupportPage({ welcome: welcomeProp }: SupportPageProps = {}) {
  const { user, profile, pendingWelcome, consumeWelcome } = useSession();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'queue' | 'assigned'>('queue');
  const [queueTickets, setQueueTickets] = useState<Ticket[]>([]);
  const [assignedTickets, setAssignedTickets] = useState<Ticket[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [selectedTicket, setSelectedTicket] = useState<Ticket | null>(null);
  const [isDetailModalVisible, setIsDetailModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isMenuVisible, setIsMenuVisible] = useState(false);

  const routeParams = useLocalSearchParams<{ welcome?: string }>();
  const isFromPropOrRoute = (welcomeProp ?? routeParams.welcome) === '1';

  const [isWelcomeModalVisible, setIsWelcomeModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const welcomeHandledRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const shouldShow = pendingWelcome || isFromPropOrRoute;
    if (shouldShow && !welcomeHandledRef.current) {
      welcomeHandledRef.current = true;
      consumeWelcome();
      setIsWelcomeModalVisible(true);
    }
  }, [pendingWelcome, isFromPropOrRoute, consumeWelcome]);

  const loadTickets = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    try {
      const [queueRes, assignedRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from('tickets')
          .select('*, requester_profile:profiles!user_id(full_name, email)')
          .eq('status', 'pending')
          .is('assigned_to', null)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: true }),
        supabase
          .from('tickets')
          .select('*, requester_profile:profiles!user_id(full_name, email)')
          .eq('assigned_to', user.id)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      ]);

      if (queueRes.data) {
        setQueueTickets(queueRes.data as unknown as Ticket[]);
      }
      if (assignedRes.data) {
        setAssignedTickets(assignedRes.data as unknown as Ticket[]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Excepción al cargar tickets de soporte:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (user?.id) {
      Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from('tickets')
          .select('*, requester_profile:profiles!user_id(full_name, email)')
          .eq('status', 'pending')
          .is('assigned_to', null)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: true }),
        supabase
          .from('tickets')
          .select('*, requester_profile:profiles!user_id(full_name, email)')
          .eq('assigned_to', user.id)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      ]).then(([queueRes, assignedRes]) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (queueRes.data) {
          setQueueTickets(queueRes.data as unknown as Ticket[]);
        }
        if (assignedRes.data) {
          setAssignedTickets(assignedRes.data as unknown as Ticket[]);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      });
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [user]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    loadTickets();
  }, [loadTickets]);

  const greeting = getContextualGreeting();
  const displayName = profile?.full_name?.trim() || user?.user_metadata?.full_name?.trim() || user?.email || 'Técnico de soporte';
  const userInitial = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  // Contadores
  const queueCount = queueTickets.length;
  const myActiveCount = assignedTickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'in_progress').length;
  const myResolvedCount = assignedTickets.filter((t) => t.status === 'resolved').length;

  // Ticket actualmente activo en atención por este especialista
  const currentActiveTicket = assignedTickets.find((t) => t.status === 'in_progress');

  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-canvas" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <ScrollView
        className="flex-1"
        contentContainerClassName="flex-grow"
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            colors={[COLORS.PETROL]}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            refreshing={refreshing}
            tintColor={COLORS.PETROL}
          />
        }>
        <View className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[440px] flex-1 px-6 pb-8">
          {/* Barra superior */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-6 pt-3">
            <AppLogo />

            {/* Píldora de rol y Menú de opciones */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sky/60 bg-white px-3 py-1.5">
                <View className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-steel" />
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[1.2px] text-steel">
                  SOPORTE
                </Text>
              </View>

              <AppMenuButton onPress={() => setIsMenuVisible(true)} />
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Tarjeta de bienvenida y perfil */}
          <View className="mt-2 rounded-3xl border border-sky/50 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-4">
              <View className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol/10">
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{userInitial}</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
                  {greeting.toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {displayName}
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {user?.email}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Banner de ticket activo en atención (si existe) */}
          {currentActiveTicket ? (
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-petrol/40 bg-petrol/5 p-4 active:bg-petrol/10"
              onPress={() => {
                setSelectedTicket(currentActiveTicket);
                setIsDetailModalVisible(true);
              }}>
              <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between pb-2">
                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
                  <View className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-coral" />
                  <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-petrol uppercase">
                    Ticket en atención activa
                  </Text>
                </View>

                <View className="rounded-lg bg-petrol px-2.5 py-1">
                  <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-white">Atender ahora &rarr;</Text>
                </View>
              </View>

              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-petrol" numberOfLines={1}>
                {currentActiveTicket.title}
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                Toca aquí para agregar observaciones o resolver la incidencia.
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}

          {/* Resumen de tickets de soporte */}
          <View className="mt-6">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[2px] text-steel">
              MÉTRICAS DE ATENCIÓN
            </Text>

            <View className="flex-row gap-3">
              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/10">
                  <TicketIcon color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{queueCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">Abiertos</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-coral/10">
                  <Clock color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{myActiveCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs text-steel">En proceso</Text>
              </View>

              <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-petrol/20 bg-petrol/5 p-4">
                <View className="mb-2 h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-petrol/15">
                  <CheckCircle2 color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{myResolvedCount}</Text>
                <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">Resueltos</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Pestañas de navegación entre Cola y Asignados */}
          <View className="mt-7 flex-row rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-1">
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              className={`flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2 ${
                activeTab === 'queue' ? 'bg-petrol shadow-sm' : 'active:bg-canvas'
              }`}
              onPress={() => setActiveTab('queue')}>
              <Headphones
                color={activeTab === 'queue' ? '#FFFFFF' : COLORS.STEEL}
                size={14}
              />
              <Text
                className={`text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-bold ${
                  activeTab === 'queue' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                }`}>
                Cola abierta ({queueCount})
              </Text>
            </Pressable>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              className={`flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-2 ${
                activeTab === 'assigned' ? 'bg-petrol shadow-sm' : 'active:bg-canvas'
              }`}
              onPress={() => setActiveTab('assigned')}>
              <UserCheck
                color={activeTab === 'assigned' ? '#FFFFFF' : COLORS.STEEL}
                size={14}
              />
              <Text
                className={`text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-bold ${
                  activeTab === 'assigned' ? 'text-white' : 'text-steel'
                }`}>
                Mis asignados ({assignedTickets.length})
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {/* Listado dinámico según la pestaña activa */}
          <View className="mt-4">
            {loading && queueTickets.length === 0 && assignedTickets.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="py-12 items-center justify-center">
                <ActivityIndicator color={COLORS.PETROL} size="large" />
                <Text className="mt-3 text-xs text-steel">Cargando tickets de soporte...</Text>
              </View>
            ) : activeTab === 'queue' ? (
              queueTickets.length === 0 ? (
                <View className="rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-7 items-center text-center shadow-sm">
                  <View className="mb-2 h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center">
                    <LottieView
                      autoPlay
                      loop
                      source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                      style={{ width: 90, height: 90 }}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
                    La cola de tickets está al día
                  </Text>
                  <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-steel max-w-[260px]">
                    No hay solicitudes pendientes sin asignar en este momento.
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                queueTickets.map((t) => (
                  <TicketCard
                    key={t.id}
                    ticket={t}
                    onPress={(clicked) => {
                      setSelectedTicket(clicked);
                      setIsDetailModalVisible(true);
                    }}
                  />
                ))
              )
            ) : assignedTickets.length === 0 ? (
              <View className="rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-7 items-center text-center shadow-sm">
                <View className="mb-2 h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center">
                  <LottieView
                    autoPlay
                    loop
                    source={welcomeBadgeAnimation}
                    style={{ width: 90, height: 90 }}
                  />
                </View>
                <Text className="text-base font-bold text-petrol">
                  Sin tickets asignados
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-1 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-steel max-w-[260px]">
                  Dirígete a la pestaña de cola para atender un ticket disponible.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              assignedTickets.map((t) => (
                <TicketCard
                  key={t.id}
                  ticket={t}
                  onPress={(clicked) => {
                    setSelectedTicket(clicked);
                    setIsDetailModalVisible(true);
                  }}
                />
              ))
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Pie de página */}
          <View className="mt-auto items-center pt-8">
            <Text className="text-xs text-steel">TickDesk · Soporte técnico · EPN</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Modal de detalle de ticket (atender, resolver, cambiar prioridad, observaciones) */}
      <TicketDetailModal
        ticket={selectedTicket}
        visible={isDetailModalVisible}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsDetailModalVisible(false);
          setSelectedTicket(null);
        }}
        onTicketUpdated={() => {
          loadTickets();
        }}
      />

      {/* Menú lateral de la aplicación (centraliza opciones de cuenta) */}
      <AppMenu
        visible={isMenuVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsMenuVisible(false)}
      />

      {/* Ventana emergente (modal) de bienvenida animada con el técnico de soporte */}
      <WelcomeModal
        visible={isWelcomeModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsWelcomeModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto';
import { AppState, Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from 'expo-sqlite/kv-store';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ?? '';
const supabasePublishableKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ?? '';

const storage =
  Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined'
    ? window.localStorage
    : AsyncStorage;

export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabasePublishableKey, {
  auth: {
    storage,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    detectSessionInUrl: false,
  },
});

AppState.addEventListener('change', (state) => {
  if (state === 'active') {
    supabase.auth.startAutoRefresh();
  } else {
    supabase.auth.stopAutoRefresh();
  }
});

import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Headphones } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

export type AppLogoVariant = 'default' | 'inverted';
export type AppLogoSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export type AppLogoProps = {
  variant?: AppLogoVariant;
  size?: AppLogoSize;
  showText?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  className?: string;
};

const SIZES = {
  sm: {
    container: 'h-10 w-10 rounded-2xl',
    iconSize: 20,
    titleSize: 'text-base font-bold tracking-tight',
    subtitleSize: 'text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[2px]',
    gap: 'gap-2.5',
  },
  md: {
    container: 'h-11 w-11 rounded-2xl',
    iconSize: 22,
    titleSize: 'text-lg font-bold tracking-tight',
    subtitleSize: 'text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[2px]',
    gap: 'gap-3',
  },
  lg: {
    container: 'h-14 w-14 rounded-3xl',
    iconSize: 28,
    titleSize: 'text-xl font-bold tracking-tight',
    subtitleSize: 'text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[2px]',
    gap: 'gap-3.5',
  },
} as const;

export function AppLogo({
  variant = 'default',
  size = 'md',
  showText = true,
  title = 'TickDesk',
  subtitle = 'SUPPORT SYSTEM',
  className = '',
}: AppLogoProps) {
  const sizeConfig = SIZES[size];
  const isInverted = variant === 'inverted';

  const containerStyle = isInverted
    ? 'border border-white/20 bg-white/15 shadow-sm'
    : 'bg-petrol shadow-sm';

  const titleColorStyle = isInverted ? '#FFFFFF' : COLORS.PETROL;
  const subtitleColorStyle = isInverted ? COLORS.SKY : COLORS.STEEL;

  return (
    <View
      accessibilityLabel={`${title} ${subtitle}`}
      accessibilityRole="header"
      className={`flex-row items-center ${sizeConfig.gap} ${className}`.trim()}>
      <View
        className={`${sizeConfig.container} items-center justify-center ${containerStyle}`}
        style={!isInverted ? { backgroundColor: COLORS.PETROL } : undefined}>
        <Headphones color="#FFFFFF" size={sizeConfig.iconSize} strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </View>

      {showText && (
        <View>
          <Text
            className={`${sizeConfig.titleSize} ${isInverted ? 'text-white' : 'text-petrol'}`}
            style={{ color: titleColorStyle }}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          {Boolean(subtitle) && (
            <Text
              className={`${sizeConfig.subtitleSize} ${isInverted ? 'text-sky' : 'text-steel'}`}
              style={{ color: subtitleColorStyle }}>
              {subtitle}
            </Text>
          )}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}
