import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
  type TextInputProps,
} from 'react-native';

import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

export type TextFieldVariant = 'default' | 'compact';

export type TextFieldProps = {
  label?: string;
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (value: string) => void;
  rightElement?: ReactNode;
  leftElement?: ReactNode;
  variant?: TextFieldVariant;
  error?: string | null;
  helperText?: string;
} & Omit<TextInputProps, 'value' | 'onChangeText'>;

export function TextField({
  label,
  rightElement,
  leftElement,
  variant = 'default',
  error,
  helperText,
  className,
  onFocus,
  onBlur,
  ...inputProps
}: TextFieldProps) {
  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = useState(false);

  const handleFocus: TextInputProps['onFocus'] = (e) => {
    setIsFocused(true);
    onFocus?.(e);
  };

  const handleBlur: TextInputProps['onBlur'] = (e) => {
    setIsFocused(false);
    onBlur?.(e);
  };

  const isCompact = variant === 'compact';
  const heightClass = isCompact ? 'h-11' : 'h-14';
  const textClass = isCompact ? 'text-xs' : 'text-[15px]';
  const paddingLeftClass = leftElement ? (isCompact ? 'pl-9' : 'pl-11') : 'pl-4';
  const paddingRightClass = rightElement ? (isCompact ? 'pr-9' : 'pr-12') : 'pr-4';

  const borderClass = error
    ? 'border-coral'
    : isFocused
      ? 'border-petrol'
      : 'border-sky';

  return (
    <View className="w-full">
      {label ? (
        <Text
          className={`mb-1.5 font-medium text-petrol ${
            isCompact ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm'
          }`}>
          {label}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <View className="relative justify-center">
        {leftElement ? (
          <View
            className={`absolute bottom-0 top-0 justify-center z-10 ${
              isCompact ? 'left-3' : 'left-3.5'
            }`}>
            {leftElement}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <TextInput
          className={`rounded-2xl border bg-white ${heightClass} ${textClass} ${paddingLeftClass} ${paddingRightClass} text-petrol ${borderClass} ${
            className || ''
          }`}
          placeholderTextColor={COLORS.STEEL}
          onBlur={handleBlur}
          onFocus={handleFocus}
          {...inputProps}
        />

        {rightElement ? (
          <View
            className={`absolute bottom-0 top-0 justify-center z-10 ${
              isCompact ? 'right-3' : 'right-4'
            }`}>
            {rightElement}
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <Text className="mt-1 text-xs text-coral font-medium">{error}</Text>
      ) : helperText ? (
        <Text className="mt-1 text-xs text-steel">{helperText}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

type AppMenuProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

type AppMenuButtonProps = {
  onPress: () => void;
};

export function AppMenuButton({ onPress }: AppMenuButtonProps) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityHint="Abre el menú de opciones y configuración de la cuenta."
      accessibilityLabel="Abrir menú"
      accessibilityRole="button"
      className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-sky/60 bg-white shadow-sm active:scale-95 active:bg-sky/20 active:border-petrol/40"
      hitSlop={6}
      onPress={onPress}>
      <Menu color={COLORS.PETROL} size={20} />
    </Pressable>
  );
}

export function AppMenu({ visible, onClose }: AppMenuProps) {
  const { user, profile } = useSession();

  const [isPasswordModalVisible, setIsPasswordModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isSignOutModalVisible, setIsSignOutModalVisible] = useState(false);

  const [slideAnim] = useState(() => new Animated.Value(340));
  const [fadeAnim] = useState(() => new Animated.Value(0));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 220,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(slideAnim, {
          toValue: 0,
          duration: 220,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]).start();
    } else {
      slideAnim.setValue(340);
      fadeAnim.setValue(0);
    }
  }, [visible, fadeAnim, slideAnim]);

  const handleClose = (callback?: () => void) => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(slideAnim, {
        toValue: 340,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start(() => {
      onClose();
      if (callback) {
        callback();
      }
    });
  };

  const displayName =
    profile?.full_name?.trim() ||
    user?.user_metadata?.full_name?.trim() ||
    user?.email ||
    'Usuario';
  const displayEmail = user?.email || profile?.email || '';
  const userInitial = displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const roleLabel =
    profile?.role === 'admin'
      ? 'ADMINISTRADOR'
      : profile?.role === 'support'
        ? 'SOPORTE TÉCNICO'
        : 'SOLICITANTE';

  const roleColorStyle =
    profile?.role === 'admin'
      ? 'border-coral/40 bg-coral/10 text-coral'
      : profile?.role === 'support'
        ? 'border-petrol/30 bg-petrol/10 text-petrol'
        : 'border-sky/70 bg-sky/30 text-steel';

  const RoleIcon =
    profile?.role === 'admin'
      ? Shield
      : profile?.role === 'support'
        ? Headphones
        : User;

  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        animationType="none"
        onRequestClose={() => handleClose()}
        transparent
        visible={visible}>
        <View className="flex-1 flex-row justify-end" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          {/* Fondo oscuro traslúcido para cerrar al pulsar fuera */}
          <Animated.View
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-petrol/60"
            style={{ opacity: fadeAnim }}>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityLabel="Cerrar menú"
              className="flex-1"
              onPress={() => handleClose()}
            />
          </Animated.View>

          {/* Panel lateral con ancho acotado y altura total garantizada */}
          <Animated.View
            className="bg-canvas shadow-2xl"
            style={{
              width: '84%',
              maxWidth: 320,
              height: '100%',
              transform: [{ translateX: slideAnim }],
            }}>
            <View className="flex-1 bg-canvas" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              {/* Encabezado con fondo Petrol que se extiende hasta la barra de estado */}
              <SafeAreaView
                className="bg-petrol"
                edges={['top']}
                style={{ backgroundColor: COLORS.PETROL }}>
                <View className="px-5 pb-5 pt-3">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
                    <AppLogo size="sm" variant="inverted" />

                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityHint="Cierra el menú lateral."
                      accessibilityLabel="Cerrar menú"
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/15 active:bg-white/30"
                      hitSlop={8}
                      onPress={() => handleClose()}>
                      <X color="#FFFFFF" size={18} />
                    </Pressable>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </SafeAreaView>

              {/* Contenido principal con ScrollView garantizando visualización completa */}
              <ScrollView
                contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, gap: 14 }}
                keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
                showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                {/* Tarjeta de perfil del usuario */}
                <View className="rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
                    <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-petrol/15 bg-petrol/10">
                      <Text className="text-2xl font-bold text-petrol">{userInitial}</Text>
                    </View>

                    <View className="flex-1">
                      <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-steel">
                        Cuenta activa
                      </Text>
                      <Text
                        className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol"
                        numberOfLines={1}>
                        {displayName}
                      </Text>
                      <Text
                        className="text-xs text-steel"
                        numberOfLines={1}>
                        {displayEmail}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>

                  {/* Insignia del rol */}
                  <View
                    className={`mt-3.5 flex-row items-center gap-1.5 self-start rounded-full border px-3 py-1 ${roleColorStyle}`}>
                    <RoleIcon
                      color={profile?.role === 'admin' ? COLORS.CORAL : COLORS.PETROL}
                      size={12}
                    />
                    <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider">
                      {roleLabel}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>

                {/* Sección de Opciones de cuenta */}
                <View>
                  <Text className="mb-2 px-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
                    Opciones de cuenta
                  </Text>

                  <View className="gap-2.5">
                    {/* Opción: Cambiar contraseña */}
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityHint="Abre la ventana para modificar tu contraseña actual."
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] active:bg-canvas"
                      onPress={() => handleClose(() => setIsPasswordModalVisible(true))}>
                      <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center gap-3">
                        <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-petrol/15 bg-petrol/10">
                          <KeyRound color={COLORS.PETROL} size={18} />
                        </View>
                        <View className="flex-1">
                          <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-petrol">
                            Cambiar contraseña
                          </Text>
                          <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                            Actualiza tu clave de acceso segura
                          </Text>
                        </View>
                      </View>
                      <ChevronRight color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
                    </Pressable>

                    {/* Opción: Cerrar sesión */}
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityHint="Abre el diálogo de confirmación para cerrar tu sesión."
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-coral/30 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] active:bg-coral/5"
                      onPress={() => handleClose(() => setIsSignOutModalVisible(true))}>
                      <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center gap-3">
                        <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-coral/20 bg-coral/10">
                          <LogOut color={COLORS.CORAL} size={18} />
                        </View>
                        <View className="flex-1">
                          <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-coral">
                            Cerrar sesión
                          </Text>
                          <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel" numberOfLines={1}>
                            Finaliza tu sesión en este dispositivo
                          </Text>
                        </View>
                      </View>
                      <ChevronRight color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                    </Pressable>
                  </View>
                </View>

                {/* Tarjeta de información de seguridad del sistema */}
                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-sky/35 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm">
                  <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-sky/30">
                    <ShieldCheck color={COLORS.PETROL} size={18} />
                  </View>
                  <View className="flex-1">
                    <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-petrol">
                      Conexión segura y cifrada
                    </Text>
                    <Text className="text-[10px] text-steel">
                      Autenticación activa protegida por Supabase SSL
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </ScrollView>

              {/* Área segura inferior para la barra de navegación de Android */}
              <SafeAreaView className="bg-canvas" edges={['bottom']} />
            </View>
          </Animated.View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Modal para cambiar contraseña */}
      <ChangePasswordModal
        visible={isPasswordModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsPasswordModalVisible(false)}
      />

      {/* Diálogo para confirmación de cierre de sesión */}
      <SignOutConfirmModal
        visible={isSignOutModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsSignOutModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import LottieView from 'lottie-react-native';

import supportAnimation from '@/shared/assets/animations/support-desk.json';

type SupportIllustrationProps = {
  compact?: boolean;
};

export function SupportIllustration({ compact = false }: SupportIllustrationProps) {
  const lottieRef = useRef<LottieView>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Garantiza inicio de reproducción en Android ante diferencias de ciclo de vida nativo
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      lottieRef.current?.play();
    }, 60);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <View
      accessible
      accessibilityLabel="Ilustración animada de un escritorio de soporte"
      accessibilityRole="image"
      className={`${
        compact ? 'h-[120px] rounded-2xl' : 'h-[160px] rounded-3xl'
      } items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-sky/40`}>
      <LottieView
        ref={lottieRef}
        autoPlay
        loop
        source={supportAnimation}
        style={{
          width: compact ? 170 : 210,
          height: compact ? 120 : 150,
        }}
      />
      <View
        className={`absolute rounded-full bg-canvas/90 ${
          compact ? 'bottom-2 right-3 px-2.5 py-0.5' : 'bottom-3 right-4 px-3 py-1'
        }`}>
        <Text
          className={`font-semibold tracking-[1.4px] text-petrol ${
            compact ? 'text-[8px]' : 'text-[9px]'
          }`}>
          SOPORTE TÉCNICO
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  Edit3,
  Headphones,
  Tag,
  Trash2,
  User,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useSession } from '@/entities/session';
import {
  TicketPriorityBadge,
  TicketStatusBadge,
  type Ticket,
  type TicketPriority,
} from '@/entities/ticket';
import { DeleteTicketModal } from '@/features/delete-ticket';
import { EditTicketModal } from '@/features/edit-ticket';
import { TicketObservationsList } from '@/features/ticket-observations';
import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { COLORS } from '@/shared/theme';

type TicketDetailModalProps = {
  ticket: Ticket | null;
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onTicketUpdated?: (ticket: Ticket) => void;
  onTicketDeleted?: (ticketId: string) => void;
};

function formatDetailDate(dateStr?: string): string {
  if (!dateStr) return 'N/A';
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr;
    return d.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

export function TicketDetailModal({
  ticket,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onTicketUpdated,
  onTicketDeleted,
}: TicketDetailModalProps) {
  const { user, profile } = useSession();

  const [activeTicket, setActiveTicket] = useState<Ticket | null>(ticket);
  const [isEditModalVisible, setIsEditModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [isDeleteModalVisible, setIsDeleteModalVisible] = useState(false);

  // Estados de soporte
  const [claiming, setClaiming] = useState(false);
  const [resolving, setResolving] = useState(false);
  const [changingPriority, setChangingPriority] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionSuccess, setActionSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPrioritySelector, setShowPrioritySelector] = useState(false);

  // Sincronizar activeTicket con prop ticket cuando cambia
  if (ticket && activeTicket?.id !== ticket.id) {
    setActiveTicket(ticket);
    setActionError(null);
    setActionSuccess(null);
    setShowPrioritySelector(false);
  }

  if (!activeTicket) return null;

  const currentRole = profile?.role;
  const isPending = activeTicket.status === 'pending';
  const isInProgress = activeTicket.status === 'in_progress';
  const isResolved = activeTicket.status === 'resolved';

  const isOwner = user?.id === activeTicket.user_id;
  const isAssignedToMe = user?.id === activeTicket.assigned_to;
  const isUnassigned = !activeTicket.assigned_to;

  // --- ACCIÓN DE SOPORTE: Reclamar ticket ---
  const handleClaimTicket = async () => {
    if (claiming) return;
    setClaiming(true);
    setActionError(null);
    setActionSuccess(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc('claim_ticket', {
        p_ticket_id: activeTicket.id,
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al reclamar ticket:', error);
        const msg = error.message.toLowerCase();
        if (msg.includes('already') || msg.includes('asignado') || msg.includes('activo')) {
          setActionError('No puedes atender este ticket: ya tienes un ticket activo asignado o fue tomado por otro especialista.');
        } else {
          setActionError(error.message || 'No se pudo reclamar el ticket.');
        }
        return;
      }

      // Actualizar estado local
      const updated: Ticket = {
        ...activeTicket,
        status: 'in_progress',
        assigned_to: user?.id || null,
      };
      setActiveTicket(updated);
      setActionSuccess('¡Ticket asignado con éxito! Ahora estás a cargo de esta incidencia.');
      if (onTicketUpdated) onTicketUpdated(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al reclamar ticket:', err);
      setActionError('Error de conexión al reclamar el ticket.');
    } finally {
      setClaiming(false);
    }
  };

  // --- ACCIÓN DE SOPORTE: Resolver ticket ---
  const handleResolveTicket = async () => {
    if (resolving) return;
    setResolving(true);
    setActionError(null);
    setActionSuccess(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc('support_update_assigned_ticket', {
        p_ticket_id: activeTicket.id,
        p_new_priority: activeTicket.priority,
        p_resolve: true,
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al resolver ticket:', error);
        setActionError(error.message || 'No se pudo marcar el ticket como resuelto.');
        return;
      }

      const updated: Ticket = {
        ...activeTicket,
        status: 'resolved',
      };
      setActiveTicket(updated);
      setActionSuccess('El ticket ha sido marcado como Resuelto.');
      if (onTicketUpdated) onTicketUpdated(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al resolver ticket:', err);
      setActionError('Error de conexión al resolver el ticket.');
    } finally {
      setResolving(false);
    }
  };

  // --- ACCIÓN DE SOPORTE: Cambiar prioridad ---
  const handleChangePriority = async (newPriority: TicketPriority) => {
    if (changingPriority || newPriority === activeTicket.priority) return;
    setChangingPriority(true);
    setActionError(null);
    setActionSuccess(null);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.rpc('support_update_assigned_ticket', {
        p_ticket_id: activeTicket.id,
        p_new_priority: newPriority,
        p_resolve: false,
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Error al cambiar prioridad:', error);
        setActionError(error.message || 'No se pudo cambiar la prioridad.');
        return;
      }

      const updated: Ticket = {
        ...activeTicket,
        priority: newPriority,
      };
      setActiveTicket(updated);
      setShowPrioritySelector(false);
      setActionSuccess(`Prioridad actualizada a ${newPriority === 'low' ? 'Baja' : newPriority === 'medium' ? 'Media' : 'Alta'}.`);
      if (onTicketUpdated) onTicketUpdated(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Excepción al cambiar prioridad:', err);
      setActionError('Error al cambiar la prioridad.');
    } finally {
      setChangingPriority(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}>
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-end bg-petrol/60 sm:justify-center p-3">
        <View className="w-full max-w-[480px] max-h-[92%] rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Cabecera */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-sky/20 pb-3">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <View className="rounded-lg bg-petrol/10 px-2 py-0.5">
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-petrol">
                  TICKET #{activeTicket.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <TicketStatusBadge status={activeTicket.status} />
            </View>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-canvas active:bg-sky/20"
              onPress={onClose}>
              <X color={COLORS.STEEL} size={18} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <ScrollView
            className="flex-grow-0"
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            <View className="py-2 gap-3.5">
              {/* Alerta de acción (error o éxito) */}
              {actionError ? (
                <View className="rounded-2xl border border-coral/30 bg-coral/10 p-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle color={COLORS.CORAL} size={16} />
                  <Text className="flex-1 text-xs font-medium text-coral">
                    {actionError}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ) : null}

              {actionSuccess ? (
                <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/60 bg-sky/20 p-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle color={COLORS.PETROL} size={16} />
                  <Text className="flex-1 text-xs font-medium text-petrol">
                    {actionSuccess}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ) : null}

              {/* Título y Categoría */}
              <View>
                <Text className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
                  {activeTicket.title}
                </Text>

                <View className="mt-2 flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-sky/40 bg-canvas px-2.5 py-0.5">
                    <Tag color={COLORS.STEEL} size={11} />
                    <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-steel">
                      {activeTicket.category || 'General'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>

                  <TicketPriorityBadge priority={activeTicket.priority} />
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Metadatos: Fechas e involucrados */}
              <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-canvas p-3.5 gap-2">
                <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Calendar color={COLORS.STEEL} size={13} />
                    <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel">Creado el:</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-petrol">
                    {formatDetailDate(activeTicket.created_at)}
                  </Text>
                </View>

                {activeTicket.requester_profile?.full_name ? (
                  <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-t border-sky/20 pt-1.5">
                    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
                      <User color={COLORS.STEEL} size={13} />
                      <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel">Solicitante:</Text>
                    </View>
                    <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-petrol">
                      {activeTicket.requester_profile.full_name}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-t border-sky/20 pt-1.5">
                  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Headphones color={COLORS.STEEL} size={13} />
                    <Text className="text-[11px] text-steel">Especialista asignado:</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Text className="text-[11px] font-medium text-petrol">
                    {activeTicket.assigned_profile?.full_name ||
                      (isAssignedToMe ? 'Tú (Soporte)' : isUnassigned ? 'Sin asignar' : 'Asignado')}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Descripción detallada */}
              <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-4">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-steel uppercase">
                  Descripción del problema
                </Text>
                <Text className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-5 text-petrol">
                  {activeTicket.description}
                </Text>
              </View>

              {/* ACCIONES PARA ROL SOLICITANTE */}
              {currentRole === 'requester' && isOwner && isPending ? (
                <View className="flex-row gap-2 pt-1">
                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className="flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-sky/60 bg-white active:bg-canvas"
                    onPress={() => setIsEditModalVisible(true)}>
                    <Edit3 color={COLORS.PETROL} size={14} />
                    <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">Editar ticket</Text>
                  </Pressable>

                  <Pressable
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    className="flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-coral/40 bg-coral/10 active:bg-coral/20"
                    onPress={() => setIsDeleteModalVisible(true)}>
                    <Trash2 color={COLORS.CORAL} size={14} />
                    <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-coral">Eliminar</Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              ) : null}

              {/* ACCIONES PARA ROL SOPORTE */}
              {currentRole === 'support' ? (
                <View className="gap-2 pt-1">
                  {/* Si el ticket está pendiente y sin asignar -> Botón Atender ticket */}
                  {isPending && isUnassigned ? (
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      className={`h-12 w-full flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-petrol active:bg-petrol/90 ${
                        claiming ? 'opacity-70' : ''
                      }`}
                      disabled={claiming}
                      onPress={handleClaimTicket}>
                      {claiming ? (
                        <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Headphones color="#FFFFFF" size={16} />
                          <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                            Atender ticket (Reclamar)
                          </Text>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Pressable>
                  ) : null}

                  {/* Si el ticket está asignado a mí y en proceso -> Cambiar prioridad / Resolver */}
                  {isAssignedToMe && isInProgress ? (
                    <View className="gap-2">
                      <View className="flex-row gap-2">
                        <Pressable
                          accessibilityRole="button"
                          className="flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-sky/60 bg-white active:bg-canvas"
                          disabled={changingPriority || resolving}
                          onPress={() => setShowPrioritySelector(!showPrioritySelector)}>
                          <Clock color={COLORS.PETROL} size={14} />
                          <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-petrol">
                            Cambiar prioridad
                          </Text>
                        </Pressable>

                        <Pressable
                          accessibilityRole="button"
                          className={`flex-1 h-11 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-petrol active:bg-petrol/90 ${
                            resolving ? 'opacity-70' : ''
                          }`}
                          disabled={resolving || changingPriority}
                          onPress={handleResolveTicket}>
                          {resolving ? (
                            <ActivityIndicator color="#FFFFFF" size="small" />
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <CheckCircle color="#FFFFFF" size={14} />
                              <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                                Resolver ticket
                              </Text>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </Pressable>
                      </View>

                      {/* Selector desplegable de nueva prioridad */}
                      {showPrioritySelector ? (
                        <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-canvas p-3">
                          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-steel mb-2">
                            Selecciona la nueva prioridad:
                          </Text>
                          <View className="flex-row gap-2">
                            {(['low', 'medium', 'high'] as const).map((p) => {
                              const isCurrent = activeTicket.priority === p;
                              const label = p === 'low' ? 'Baja' : p === 'medium' ? 'Media' : 'Alta';
                              const activeColor = p === 'high' ? 'bg-coral' : p === 'medium' ? 'bg-petrol' : 'bg-steel';

                              return (
                                <Pressable
                                  key={p}
                                  accessibilityRole="button"
                                  className={`flex-1 h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border ${
                                    isCurrent ? `${activeColor} border-transparent` : 'border-sky/50 bg-white'
                                  }`}
                                  disabled={changingPriority}
                                  onPress={() => handleChangePriority(p)}>
                                  <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${isCurrent ? 'text-white' : 'text-petrol'}`}>
                                    {label}
                                  </Text>
                                </Pressable>
                              );
                            })}
                          </View>
                        </View>
                      ) : null}
                    </View>
                  ) : null}

                  {isResolved ? (
                    <View className="rounded-2xl border border-sky/30 bg-sky/10 p-3 flex-row items-center gap-2">
                      <CheckCircle color={COLORS.STEEL} size={16} />
                      <Text className="text-xs text-steel">
                        Este ticket ha sido resuelto y cerrado.
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ) : null}
                </View>
              ) : null}

              {/* SECCIÓN DE OBSERVACIONES / HILO DE COMENTARIOS */}
              <TicketObservationsList
                ticket={activeTicket}
                ticketId={activeTicket.id}
              />
            </View>
          </ScrollView>

          {/* Botón de cierre inferior */}
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            className="mt-3 h-11 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-sky/40 bg-white active:bg-canvas"
            onPress={onClose}>
            <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-steel">Cerrar detalle</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Modal de edición */}
      <EditTicketModal
        ticket={activeTicket}
        visible={isEditModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsEditModalVisible(false)}
        onSuccess={(updated) => {
          setActiveTicket(updated);
          setActionSuccess('Ticket actualizado con éxito.');
          if (onTicketUpdated) onTicketUpdated(updated);
        }}
      />

      {/* Modal de confirmación de eliminación */}
      <DeleteTicketModal
        ticket={activeTicket}
        visible={isDeleteModalVisible}
        onClose={() => setIsDeleteModalVisible(false)}
        onSuccess={(deletedId) => {
          setIsDeleteModalVisible(false);
          onClose();
          if (onTicketDeleted) onTicketDeleted(deletedId);
        }}
      />
    </Modal>
  );
}

import LottieView from "lottie-react-native";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Modal, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import techWelcomeAnimation from "@/shared/assets/animations/tech-welcome.json";

type WelcomeModalProps = {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export function WelcomeModal({ visible, onClose }: WelcomeModalProps) {
  const lottieRef = useRef<LottieView>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      // Garantizar inicio de reproducción en Android tras el montaje nativo
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        lottieRef.current?.play();
      }, 80);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [visible]);

  return (
    <Modal
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
      transparent
      visible={visible}
    >
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-petrol/60 px-6">
        <View className="w-full max-w-[380px] items-center rounded-3xl border border-sky/40 bg-white p-6 shadow-xl">
          {/* Píldora de estado superior */}
          <View className="mb-2 rounded-full border border-sky/60 bg-sky/20 px-3 py-1">
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[1.5px] text-steel">
              SISTEMA DE SOPORTE
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* Personaje animado: técnico de soporte informático saludando */}
          <View className="my-2 h-[180px] w-[180px] items-center justify-center">
            <LottieView
              ref={lottieRef}
              autoPlay
              loop
              source={techWelcomeAnimation}
              style={{ width: 180, height: 180 }}
            />
          </View>

          {/* Título principal */}
          <Text className="text-center text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-petrol">
            ¡Bienvenido a TickDesk!
          </Text>

          {/* Mensaje principal */}
          <Text className="mt-2.5 text-center text-[15px] leading-6 text-steel">
            ¡Qué bueno tenerte de vuelta! Tu espacio de soporte técnico está
            listo.
          </Text>

          {/* Botón de confirmación */}
          <Pressable
            accessibilityHint="Cierra la bienvenida y te lleva a tu panel de control."
            accessibilityRole="button"
            className="mt-6 h-14 w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-petrol active:opacity-90"
            onPress={onClose}
          >
            <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-white">
              Continuar
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}
